Slater praised Styles for handling the immense pressure of signing with a major promotion early in his career while remaining remarkably humble. Because of their shared experiences as young rising stars trying to find their way, Slater believes a future match between them in TNA would be a truly meaningful and dream-like moment.

stories.title: Rhino reveals early hesitation to use the Gore due to Goldberg comparisons
stories.tldr: ECW legend Rhino recently revealed that he was initially hesitant to use his signature finishing move because he feared being accused of copying Goldberg and Edge. Veteran wrestler Tracy Smothers eventually convinced him to perform it anyway, leading to Paul Heyman naming it the Gore and Steve Lombardi later recommending it as a WWE finisher. Additionally, Rhino shared fond memories of traveling with the late Sabu, highlighting the unpredictable star's surprisingly kind and pious demeanor away from the ring.

stories.title: Jinder Mahal explains why working independent wrestling shows is currently not fun
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Jinder Mahal recently revealed on Busted Open that he has stopped taking independent wrestling bookings after being away from the major promotion for over two years. Mahal explained that while he still loves the wrestling business and enjoys interacting with young talent, the independent scene is currently not fun for him. He emphasized that presentation and professionalism are the primary factors in his decision-making process. Although he does not require the biggest crowds, he ultimately stepped back because the current environment is simply not a good look for him.

stories.title: Historical pro wrestling anniversaries and match retrospectives for September 14
stories.tldr: Shifting to September 14, the wrestling history spotlight turns to major American tournaments and milestone title changes. Key historical moments include the conclusion of the WWE Cruiserweight Classic in 2016 where TJ Perkins defeated Gran Metalik, and Vince McMahon's surprising WWF Championship win in 1999. The date also boasts numerous other historic title changes and acclaimed matches spanning decades across multiple promotions.

stories.title: Cedric Alexander added to TNA Bound for Glory X-Division Title match
stories.tldr: Former champion Cedric Alexander has officially been added to the vacant X-Division Championship match at TNA Bound for Glory 2026, using his automatic rematch clause following his loss to Leon Slater at Lockdown. Alexander joins Fabian Aichner and KC Navarro in the six-way scramble scheduled for October 11 in Tampa, Florida, leaving three spots still open in the title bout.

stories.title: Masha Slamovich signs contract with MLW as Women's Champion
stories.tldr: Masha Slamovich has officially signed a contract with Major League Wrestling and is the promotion's new Women's Champion. She captured the title by defeating Shotzi Blackheart at the Fightland tapings in South Carolina, following an earlier win over Lady Frost. Reports indicate Slamovich secretly signed in July as part of a plan to align with the Contra Unit faction.

stories.title: Ric Flair Denies WWE Return Rumors and Confirms AEW Contract
stories.tldr: Ric Flair has strongly shut down recent online rumors suggesting he is returning to WWE, calling the speculation both untrue and disrespectful to AEW and Tony Khan. The rumors stemmed from an old 2023 interview on Booker T's podcast that recently resurfaced and was mistaken for a current development. Flair confirmed he remains happily under contract with AEW, citing his loyalty and friendship with Khan, who grants him freedom for his various outside business ventures.

stories.title: Athena Participating in Bayley's Lodestone Wrestling Camp
stories.tldr: ROH World Champion Athena is reportedly scheduled to participate in the upcoming Lodestone training camp organized by WWE star Bayley, which will take place across two cities in Texas over the next week. Private invitations have been extended to several camp alumni, with many participants also expected to appear at an upcoming event hosted by Athena and her Metroplex Wrestling promotion. The camp's timing aligns with upcoming WWE television events in Texas, continuing the initiative that previously held camps in Orlando and Las Vegas. Meanwhile, Bayley recently returned to WWE television following a brief hiatus and ongoing discussions regarding her contract status.

stories.title: Chris Jericho and Billy Corgan Featured on Accept Album
stories.tldr: Wrestling star Chris Jericho and Smashing Pumpkins frontman Billy Corgan are featured guests on the new album from heavy metal band Accept. Titled Teutonic Titans 1976-2026, the 50th-anniversary release features newly recorded versions of the band classic tracks with various all-star guest lineups. Jericho appears on the closing song alongside notable rock and metal musicians, while Corgan is featured on a separate track with his own star-studded backing credits. The milestone project was released through Napalm Records.

stories.title: MJF, Sting, and Mercedes Moné Advertised for Manchester Convention
stories.tldr: Top professional wrestlers MJF, Sting, and Mercedes Moné are advertised to appear at the upcoming For the Love of Wrestling convention. The fan event will take place at Manchester's BEC Arena on February 6 and 7, 2027. Attendees can purchase separate tickets for autographs and photo opportunities, while fans unable to make the trip can utilize an official send-in service.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Reflects on AEW World Championship Victory
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay recently reflected on his monumental AEW World Championship victory over Kenny Omega at AEW All In London 2026. Making history as the first English wrestler to win a world title on home soil, Ospreay detailed his busy post-match routine at Wembley Stadium. After receiving medical attention for gashes and washing blood from his hair, he celebrated with donuts, old friends, and plenty of vodka.

stories.title: MVP Recalls Professional Wrestling Drug Culture
stories.tldr: AEW star MVP recently reflected on the pervasive drug culture that existed within professional wrestling locker rooms when he first entered the major leagues. Speaking on his podcast, he recalled seeing veteran stars incapacitated in catering and noted that substance abuse was often used to cope with injuries or to fit in with the boys. MVP avoided the trap entirely, drawing on his resilience from his time before wrestling and watching WWE's Wellness Policy eventually dismantle this dangerous subculture.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett Praises AEW All In 2026
stories.tldr: AEW star and executive Jeff Jarrett recently praised AEW All In 2026 on his My World podcast, arguing that the massive event raised the standard for the entire professional wrestling industry. He noted that success for one major brand ultimately benefits promotions of all sizes across the globe. The historic Wembley Stadium card featured major title changes including Will Ospreay defeating Kenny Omega and Mercedes Mone capturing the women's championship. Meanwhile, WWE ran its competing NXT Heatwave event on the exact same day, highlighting a busy and competitive day for the sport.

stories.title: AEW's Maya World Names Favorite Childhood Wrestlers
stories.tldr: AEW star Maya World recently revealed that her very first favorite childhood wrestlers were Kelly Kelly and The Undertaker, despite being primarily inspired to step into the ring by later opponents like Athena and Mercedes Mone. World grew up watching the Divas division and felt a strong connection to Kelly Kelly during her WWE run in the late 2000s and early 2010s. This early fandom highlights the diverse influences that shaped the current AEW rising star's journey into professional wrestling.

stories.title: Orange Cassidy Discusses Fan Interactions and Inspiration
stories.tldr: AEW star Orange Cassidy recently revealed in an interview with Simon Miller that fans have told him his relaxed attitude actually inspired them to care more about their lives rather than give up. Cassidy explained that supporters have shared how his on-screen persona encouraged them to stop worrying and pursue what they truly wanted to do. This heartwarming fan interaction comes at a busy time for Cassidy, who recently competed on Collision alongside his Conglomeration stablemates. The group remains active in AEW's tag team and trios division following recent matches at All In and subsequent events.

stories.title: The Blade and Evil Uno Pairing for Mystery Wrestling Commentary
stories.tldr: The Blade is set to join Evil Uno on commentary for the upcoming Mystery Wrestling 29 event in Toronto. The show takes place on Sunday, September 13, at The Rec Room, with doors opening at 13:30 and the free live stream beginning at 14:00 Eastern. While The Blade is confirmed for the broadcast team, the promotion is keeping the rest of the card entirely secret. Fans can tune in to the unique, surprise-filled event through Evil Uno's Twitch channel or the official Mystery Wrestling YouTube broadcast.

stories.title: Tributes, Charity Donations, and Backstage Plans Following the Passing of 'The Butcher' Andy Williams
stories.tldr: Following the passing of Andy The Butcher Williams at age 48, AEW has honored him with dedicated tribute events and a charitable battle royal won by Daniel Garcia. In addition to these tributes, Tony Khan revealed that Williams had been discussing a potential backstage role with the company prior to his passing. Furthermore, AEW has released a previously unaired 2021 house show highlighting both Williams and Tanea Rebel Brooks.

stories.title: Brian Cage Expresses Frustration and Discusses Steroid Use
stories.tldr: Building on his recent comments about steroid and PED use, AEW star Brian Cage has revealed that he feels underutilized in the company despite being a six-year veteran. In a new interview, Cage also debunked common myths surrounding "roid rage" and shared how he was falsely accused of using substances long before his first cycle.

stories.title: AEW All Out 2026 Match Card Speculation
stories.tldr: As the September pay-per-view approaches, creative discussions are centering on whether Mercedes Mone will defend her women's world title against Thekla in a singles bout or in a three-way match involving Willow Nightingale. Several other marquee bouts are locking into place, including a high-stakes tag team ladder match and a women's tag team street fight. Additional television storylines are also heavily teasing upcoming championship matches for the trios, national, TNT, and TBS titles.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa Outlines Goal for AEW World Title
stories.tldr: Tommaso Ciampa previously revealed his desire for extended feuds with MJF and Jon Moxley in AEW. Expanding on his future plans, the former champion outlined a deliberate, slow-burn strategy to eventually capture the AEW World Championship. Ciampa explained that a successful first year involves establishing himself as a main event player while collecting other accolades and navigating the promotion's deep roster. He prefers a gradual ascent through secondary titles and tournaments rather than an immediate hot-shot push to the top.

stories.title: Ric Flair Retrospectives and Career Comments
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Ric Flair recently opened up about the staggering physical toll, brutal scheduling, and extravagant lifestyle that defined his legendary career as The Nature Boy. He reflected on his grueling workload, claiming he had only 17 days off between 1982 and 1985 and wrestled a total of 5,772 matches throughout his career. Flair also discussed the blurred lines between his real life and his wrestling persona, admitting to buying 320 pairs of alligator shoes and living the high-roller lifestyle to maintain authenticity. Additionally, he praised Triple H as the person who understood the behind-the-scenes political side of professional wrestling better than anyone else.

stories.title: Liv Morgan Media Interviews and Personal Revelations
stories.tldr: In a recent interview with IGN, WWE star Liv Morgan shared several personal revelations, including her pick for the ultimate match to show a new fan and the surprising fact that she is a legally ordained minister. She named her SummerSlam 2024 bout against Rhea Ripley as the best representation of WWE's spirit and also discussed quirky personal preferences like her liking for the smell of gasoline. Furthermore, Morgan touched upon historical WWE storylines she admires, expressing a particular fondness for the Attitude Era faction Right To Censor.

stories.title: AJ Styles Reflects on WWE Career and Royal Rumble History
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently reflected on major milestones from his decade-long WWE career, ranging from his surprise 2016 Royal Rumble debut to his final match against GUNTHER at the 2026 Royal Rumble in Saudi Arabia. He recalled the frantic medical checks, getting gear from Samoa Joe, and the secrecy surrounding his initial arrival, as well as being flown in as a last-minute replacement for an ill Bray Wyatt to wrestle Finn Balor at TLC 2017. Throughout these reflections, Styles shared intimate details about his mindset during iconic moments like his stone-faced entrance and his decision to wait until Atlanta to officially drop his wrestling gloves.

stories.title: Becky Lynch Media Appearances and Personal Stories
stories.tldr: WWE star Becky Lynch recently opened up about the terrifying first thirty seconds after her daughter Roux was born in December 2020, recalling the panic she felt when the baby did not cry immediately and medical staff had to intervene. In addition to sharing this personal birth story on the Harland Highway Podcast, Lynch is expanding her media presence outside of the ring. She is slated to appear as a guest on the upcoming YouTube series Boy Talk, hosted by actor Paul Walter Hauser and Julian Sergi.

stories.title: WWE Roster Moves and Brand Draft Speculation
stories.tldr: As WWE roster movement and draft speculation continues, analysts have identified key superstars on both Monday Night Raw and Friday Night SmackDown who are in dire need of a change in scenery. Names like Carmelo Hayes, Jordynne Grace, and Drew McIntyre are highlighted as prime candidates to move to Raw to revitalize their momentum and chase prominent titles. Meanwhile, stars such as Ivy Nile, Seth Rollins, and Iyo Sky are seen as strong contenders for a switch to SmackDown to escape directionless booking and find fresh matchups.

stories.title: Solo Sikoa, Seth Rollins, and LA Knight Perform Too Cool Dance at WWE Live Event
stories.tldr: During a WWE live event in Santiago, Chile, Solo Sikoa, Seth Rollins, and LA Knight surprised fans by performing the iconic Too Cool dance to the tune of Jey Usos entrance music. The lighthearted moment served as a special tribute to Sikoas father, Rikishi, who was part of the original Too Cool trio alongside Scotty 2 Hotty and Grandmaster Sexay. Jey Uso eventually joined the group in the ring, leading the lively Chilean crowd in a series of YEET chants. The memorable house show also featured a major title change as Stephanie Vaquer defeated Liv Morgan to capture the WWE Womens World Championship in front of her home-country fans.

stories.title: Sol Ruca Considers Adding a Second Finishing Move
stories.tldr: Sol Ruca recently addressed the potential downside of her highly recognizable finishing move, the Sol Snatcher, noting that fans are often conditioned to only expect a match to end with her signature maneuver. To combat this limitation on false finishes, she relies heavily on ring psychology, emotion, and facial expressions to build suspense for other pinning predicaments. Ruca is also open to eventually adding a secondary finisher, likely a submission or a power move, though she plans to stick with just the Sol Snatcher for the immediate future. That singular focus will serve her well as she prepares for the upcoming women's Money in the Bank ladder match in New Orleans.

stories.title: The Rock Details 50-Pound Weight Loss
stories.tldr: Dwayne Johnson recently explained why he dropped nearly 50 pounds, going from a massive 282 down to 235 pounds. The extreme size was required for his roles in The Smashing Machine and Disney's live-action Moana, which left him injured and exhausted after carrying the extra weight for over eight months. Instead of using a harsh Hollywood crash diet, he took about a year to safely drop the weight himself while preparing for his upcoming role as the Chicken Man in Benny Safdie's Lizard Music.

stories.title: Retrospective Compilation of 1996 WWE Main Events
stories.tldr: A newly released retrospective video compiles every World Wrestling Entertainment pay-per-view main event from the pivotal year of 1996. The footage highlights legendary matches and defining rivalries of the era, heavily featuring Shawn Michaels defending the WWE Championship against top challengers. Key featured bouts include historic encounters with Bret Hart, The British Bulldog, Vader, Mankind, and Psycho Sid.

stories.title: WWE Counter-Programming Analysis
stories.tldr: A lifelong wrestling fan and regular WWE viewer argues that WWE and TKO should abandon their deliberate strategy of counter-programming All Elite Wrestling events. The author notes that scheduling major WWE and NXT shows on the same days as major AEW pay-per-views hurts WWE's own developmental brands by treating them as sacrificial lambs. Ultimately, this aggressive scheduling tactic backfires because fans forced to choose will prioritize the biggest AEW events over overlapping WWE programming.

stories.title: Speculation on Future WWE First-Time World Champions
stories.tldr: Following Sami Zayn's recent world championship success, speculation is high regarding which roster members will capture their first major WWE title over the next year. Five distinct stars, including Penta, Johnny Gargano, Je'Von Evans, Dominik Mysterio, and Oba Femi, have been highlighted as prime candidates to reach the top of the mountain. These competitors possess unique momentum, upcoming high-stakes opportunities, and undeniable backing from fans and veterans alike.

stories.title: WWE Stars Potential Exclusion from Money in the Bank 2026
stories.tldr: As WWE prepares for the October 10 Money in the Bank 2026 premium live event in New Orleans, limited ladder match spots and shifting championship plans mean several top names could miss the card. Following recent dramatic title changes and storyline developments, both CM Punk and Cody Rhodes find themselves in precarious positions regarding their participation at the event. Punk recently lost his Undisputed WWE Championship to Sami Zayn, opening up multiple potential feuds instead of an immediate rematch. Meanwhile, Cody Rhodes is dealing with character fallout after failing to punt kick Randy Orton, leaving his path forward and placement on the upcoming pay-per-view uncertain.

stories.title: Lacey Evans Shares In-Ring Training Video Ahead of Potential Return
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Lacey Evans, now known by her real name Macey Estrella, has shared footage of herself training in the ring at D-Von Dudley wrestling school. Estrella has not wrestled since July 2023 following her departure from WWE, where she spent seven years under contract. Having previously teased a return to the squared circle in April, her latest social media post suggests she is seriously preparing for a comeback.

stories.title: Mickie James Discusses Nick Aldis' WWE In-Ring Debut
stories.tldr: Mickie James recently reflected on the emotional weekend surrounding her husband Nick Aldis finally making his long-awaited WWE in-ring debut against GUNTHER at SummerSlam 2026. During a recent interview, James shared how meaningful the milestone was for Aldis and their son Donovan, who bonded closely with his father throughout the training process. Although Aldis ultimately came up short and submitted to GUNTHER, the unforgettable experience proved to be a storybook moment that deeply impressed fans and backstage officials alike.

stories.title: Dexter Lumis Reflects on Connection with Bray Wyatt
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Dexter Lumis recently opened up about his long-standing bond with the late Bray Wyatt, which began during a 2009 Florida Championship Wrestling tryout. Lumis recalled how Wyatt consistently welcomed him with kindness and even brainstormed future creative ideas during their later WWE extra appearances. Although the two never shared a ring before Wyatt's tragic passing in August 2023, Lumis ultimately honored his friend's legacy by joining the mystical Wyatt Sicks faction.

stories.title: NXT GM Robert Stone Comments on Brand Status
stories.tldr: NXT General Manager Robert Stone recently pushed back against the long-running label of NXT being merely a developmental brand during an appearance on Busted Open Radio. While acknowledging that the show helps talent hone their craft before reaching the next level, Stone argued that NXT possesses its own distinct aesthetic, style, and match quality that rivals Raw and SmackDown. This debate echoes past comments from WWE executives like Paul Triple H Levesque and Shawn Michaels, who have offered differing perspectives on the brand identity as NXT continues its run on The CW network.

stories.title: Je'Von Evans Pursuing WWE Championship Records
stories.tldr: WWE star Je'Von Evans has set his sights on making history by breaking multiple company championship records while still in his early twenties. Currently competing on the Raw brand, the 22-year-old has openly stated his ambition to become the youngest world champion and youngest Intercontinental champion in WWE history. Analysts have also identified the United States Championship as another potential milestone he could claim under the modern WWE banner. He has until late 2027 and late 2028 respectively to capture these prestigious titles and cement his name in the record books.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Praises WWE Hall of Famer Influence
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes recently credited WWE Hall of Famer Rey Mysterio as the pivotal reason his wrestling career reached its current heights. During a recent interview, Rhodes highlighted their 2011 WrestleMania feud in his hometown as the foundation of his success. He also reflected on the creative freedom of that rivalry, including the origin of his Undashing persona and why he famously refused to put paper bags on audience members.

stories.title: Surprise Backstage Reaction to WWE Developmental Releases
stories.tldr: WWE recently released several developmental talents, including Anya Rune, Adriana Rizzo, Jasper Troy, and longtime performer Wendy Choo. While Choo's seven-year tenure and recent run as EVOLVE Women's Champion initially shocked many backstage, analysts noted that her inability to reach the main roster made her departure unsurprising. Her previous injuries, coupled with the assessment that her gimmicks would not succeed on Raw or SmackDown, ultimately contributed to her release.

stories.title: Teil Rhodes Comments on Potential Cody Rhodes Heel Turn
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes sister Teil recently addressed the persistent rumors surrounding a potential heel turn for the WWE star during a recent radio appearance. While acknowledging that some fans are eager to see him switch to the dark side, she remains doubtful because his natural inclination is to do the right thing. The speculation intensified following a bloody feud with Randy Orton where Cody recently showed mercy instead of delivering a vicious punt kick. Although Cody himself has softened his stance on never turning heel in the lead up to WrestleMania 42, his sister maintains a never say never attitude while enjoying his current success.

stories.title: Ricky Steamboat Documentary Released
stories.tldr: A newly released full-length documentary titled Ricky Steamboat: The Life Story of The Dragon chronicles the legendary career and personal life of the WWE Hall of Famer. The film details his early training under Vern Gagne, his rise in the Florida territory where he received his iconic ring name, and his legendary rivalries with icons like Ric Flair and Randy Macho Man Savage. It also highlights his tag team success with Jay Youngblood, his transition into a backstage producer role, his emotional 2009 Hall of Fame induction, and his memorable in-ring return against Chris Jericho at WrestleMania XXV.

stories.title: Triple H Highlights Charisma as Top Recruit Priority for WWE
stories.tldr: WWE Chief Content Officer Paul Triple H Levesque recently discussed the key attributes the company looks for when scouting and signing new talent. While traditional traits like athleticism, drive, and physical endurance remain essential during rigorous tryouts, he emphasized that charisma is the single most vital quality. Ultimately, WWE is searching for larger than life individuals who possess the unique ability to captivate a live crowd.

stories.title: WWE 2K26 Added to PlayStation Plus Game Catalog
stories.tldr: WWE 2K26 is officially heading to the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog for Extra and Premium members on September 15. Sony made the announcement on September 9, revealing that the PlayStation 5 version of the wrestling title will be included in the upcoming monthly drop. The game features a dedicated CM Punk Showcase mode highlighting his career, historic rivalries, and alternate-history scenarios, alongside a massive roster of current Superstars and legends. Subscribers should note that lineup availability can vary by region.

stories.title: Stephanie Vaquer Wins WWE Women's World Title in Chile and Appears on Raw
stories.tldr: Stephanie Vaquer recently captured the WWE Women's World Championship from Liv Morgan at a live event in Santiago, Chile, with help from special guest referee Becky Lynch. Following her historic victory, WWE filmed a mini-documentary about her homecoming and is considering releasing the full match on YouTube. The newly crowned champion is now scheduled to appear on Monday Night Raw in Mexico City to celebrate her title win.

stories.title: Sami Zayn Regains Undisputed WWE Championship from CM Punk
stories.tldr: Following his title win, Sami Zayn has publicly celebrated his second championship reign on social media. Backstage reports have revealed that CM Punk went off-script during a fiery pre-match promo, while new details about the chaotic finish have come to light. Meanwhile, analysts are examining how Zayn's championship fits into the company's broader business strategy under TKO.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio Discusses Retirement Plans and Family Goals
stories.tldr: Rey Mysterio has no set date for his eventual retirement, revealing he plans to simply wing it while enjoying his current schedule and active role on television. Physically feeling great and injury-free, the veteran is open to staying involved in the wrestling business behind the scenes as a creative or mentor once his in-ring career concludes. Meanwhile, he also noted that his daughter Aalyah has begun training for a potential career in the industry.

stories.title: Joe Gacy Discusses Wyatt Sicks Creative Plans and Alexa Bliss
stories.tldr: Building on his recent revelations about joining the Wyatt Sicks, former WWE star Joe Gacy has shared new details regarding the faction's scrapped creative plans and backstage frustrations. Gacy revealed that members frequently felt like glorified props with unused pitches, and the group's momentum stalled when Bo Dallas was injured. He also expressed surprise that Alexa Bliss was ultimately never integrated into the stable despite early discussions and meetings.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez Targets Potential Match with AJ Lee
stories.tldr: Roxanne Perez recently earned a AAA title shot after missing an opportunity with the promotion at age 16. Expanding her ambitions, Perez has now set her sights on AJ Lee, stating in a recent interview that she wants to face and ultimately retire the returning star. Perez called out Lee's current absence from television, questioning her commitment as she looks toward a potential dream match.

stories.title: WWE Perth Event Tickets Go On Sale
stories.tldr: WWE has officially launched three-event combo ticket sales for its major December return to Perth, Australia. Fans can now purchase packages through Ticketek for the December 11 SmackDown, the December 12 Wrestlepalooza event, and the December 14 Raw at RAC Arena. This run is part of a newly established partnership with Tourism Western Australia running through 2028 that brings an annual takeover to the city. Single-event tickets and detailed schedules for additional fan experiences will be released at a later date.

stories.title: El Grande Americano Defeats Dominik Mysterio for AAA Mega Title at Triplemanía 34
stories.tldr: El Grande Americano defeated Dominik Mysterio on the second night of Triplemanía 34 to capture the AAA Mega Championship, ending Mysterio's one-year reign. The chaotic No Disqualification match featured heavy outside interference from JD McDonagh, Liv Morgan, Omos, Dorian Roldan, and Los Americanos. Ultimately, AAA General Manager Rey Mysterio shocked the wrestling world by donning a referee shirt and counting the decisive pinfall against his own son. Ludwig Kaiser currently portrays the beloved babyface character of El Grande Americano, while Pete Dunne produced the main event.

stories.title: Wrestling Media and Podcast Updates
stories.tldr: Recent wrestling media coverage highlights extensive podcast reviews of TripleMania, SmackDown, and Collision, alongside emotional tributes for the passing of Andy The Butcher Williams and Bill Dundee. Audio shows also examined historical wrestling stewardship, creative shakeups, and various roster developments across major promotions. Meanwhile, a look back at past rumors highlights executive departures, WrestleMania planning, and locker room dynamics, as former talent Rebel campaigns for crucial ALS legislation funding before a looming congressional deadline.

stories.title: La Catalina Wins AAA Reina de Reinas Title at Triplemanía 34
stories.tldr: La Catalina made history at AAA Triplemania 34 Night Two by defeating Flammer to capture the AAA Reina de Reinas Championship. This victory ended Flammer's historic, record-breaking title reign at 1,128 days. As a result of her win, Catalina is now scheduled to defend her newly won championship against Roxanne Perez at WWE Worlds Collide on September 26. Perez earned this number one contender opportunity by winning a fatal four-way match on the first night of Triplemania 34.

stories.title: Los Perros del Mal Return and Theme Music at AAA Triplemanía 34
stories.tldr: During night two of AAA Triplemania 34 in Mexico City, the newly crowned AAA Trios Champions Los Perros del Mal made a dominant statement following the cruiserweight championship match. The faction forced referee and producer Adrian Butler to play their iconic theme song, Perros by Cartel de Santa, which received a massive reaction from the live crowd. They then proceeded to deliver a brutal post-match beatdown to Rey Fenix, Nathan Frazer, Jack Cartwheel, and Mini Vikingo. Even though Fenix successfully retained his cruiserweight title earlier in the evening, Los Perros del Mal completely stole the spotlight and turned the arena into a scene of total destruction.

stories.title: The Wagner Brothers Win AAA Tag Team Titles from War Raiders
stories.tldr: The Wagner Brothers captured the AAA World Tag Team Championships at AAA Triplemania 34 Night 2 by answering an open challenge issued by the War Raiders. Erik and Ivar had held the titles for 106 days since winning them in May 2026, but their gamble backfired when El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. and Galeno secured the victory. The decisive sequence saw a Wagner Driver from Dr. Wagner Jr. followed by a top-rope splash from Galeno to end the title reign. This victory marks the first time The Wagner Brothers have won a championship within AAA.

stories.title: Pagano Betrays Psycho Clown at AAA Triplemanía 34
stories.tldr: At AAA Triplemania 34 Night Two in Mexico City, Pagano made a shocking return during a brutal Mexican Street Fight between Psycho Clown and El Carnicero. Instead of saving his former ally, Pagano stepped aside to allow Carnicero to secure the pinfall victory and later handed him a kendo stick to continue the beating. This betrayal revealed that Pagano was in cahoots with Carnicero, exposing the truth behind months of attacks on the Psycho Circus.

stories.title: Omos Wins Copa Bardahl at AAA Triplemanía 34
stories.tldr: Omos dominated AAA Triplemania 34 in Mexico City by winning the 15-man Copa Bardahl for the second consecutive year on night two. On night one, he defeated Rey Mysterio to earn reinstatement in the promotion, which he followed up by brutally assaulting Mysterio and the AAA general manager. Additionally, the dominant giant recently went viral for sharing a detailed, four-step personal hygiene routine for professional wrestling fans.

stories.title: Missy Hyatt Auctions Off Her Breast Implant
stories.tldr: Wrestling personality Missy Hyatt, famously known as The First Lady of Professional Wrestling and The Walking Riot, is holding a unique online auction for one of her former breast implants. Bidding for the unusual piece of memorabilia starts at $1500 and is being handled through direct messages on Facebook. The winning bidder will receive the implant along with a certificate of authenticity signed by the doctor who removed and prepared it, as well as Hyatt's own signature. The auction is scheduled to officially close at noon on September 20, 2026.

stories.title: Borden Brothers Set to Team at Rhodes Wrestling Association
stories.tldr: Steven and Garrett Borden, the sons of wrestling legend Sting, are set to team up in the ring for the very first time at Rhodes Wrestling Association on November 8. The announcement came after Garrett secured a victory at a recent RWA event on September 13, only to be attacked post-match until his brother Steven ran out to make the save. This major tag team milestone follows Steven making his own televised in-the-ring debut on AEW Dynamite, where he teamed with Darby Allin to defeat Mark Davis and Josh Alexander.

stories.title: Octagon Jr. Attends AAA Triplemanía 34 Night Two
stories.tldr: Octagon Jr. made an appearance at Night 2 of AAA Triplemania 34 while continuing to recover from a serious neck injury suffered in May. The former AAA Latin American Champion previously shared a heartfelt social media message thanking medical staff, family, and fans for their overwhelming support. Although he remains sidelined, his presence at the major event offered a positive sign to the lucha libre community as he works toward a future in-ring return.

stories.title: AAA Triplemanía 34 Announces Sold-Out Crowd
stories.tldr: AAA TripleManía 34 Night Two kicked off in front of a packed Arena CDMX in Mexico City on September 13. During the opening Copa Bardahl Battle Royal, JBL announced that the event was a complete sell-out with an official attendance of 18,204 fans. This massive crowd provided an electric atmosphere for a stacked card featuring high-profile championship matches.

stories.title: Sting, JBL, and Ron Simmons Scheduled for NTX Universe
stories.tldr: Legendary wrestling figures Sting, JBL, and Ron Simmons are among the featured guests advertised for the upcoming NTX Universe convention in Dallas. The massive card and collectibles event is scheduled to take place from October 16 through October 18 at the Kay Bailey Hutchison Convention Center. Fans attending the convention can also meet other notable wrestling personalities like Lex Luger, Sgt. Slaughter, Mickie James, and Kelly Kelly across the weekend. Admission tickets start at 10 dollars, though autographs and professional photo opportunities require separate purchases.

stories.title: Kurt Angle Guest Coaching at NWL Manchester
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Kurt Angle is scheduled to appear as a guest coach for the National Wrestling League event in Manchester, England, on September 27. In addition to his coaching duties, Angle will host a pre-show VIP meet and greet for fans at the Bowlers Exhibition Centre. The upcoming event features a unique league format with 15-minute matches, points for victories and draws, and a lineup of notable talent including Wolfgang and Rampage Brown.

stories.title: Ric Flair and Ricky Morton Appearing at Bristol NASCAR Event
stories.tldr: Wrestling legends Ric Flair and Ricky Morton are scheduled to make special appearances during the upcoming NASCAR weekend at Bristol Motor Speedway from September 17 to September 19. Flair will appear on Trackside Live on Saturday, September 19, and his brand, Flair Spirits, is sponsoring driver Josh Bilicki's No. 66 Ford in the Bass Pro Shops Night Race. Meanwhile, Ricky Morton and a lineup of other wrestling stars will participate in the speedway's Fan Zone wrestling program across Friday and Saturday, featuring matches, a championship finale, and fan meet-and-greets at no extra cost to attendees.

stories.title: Zuffa's Potential Expansion into Professional Boxing
stories.tldr: Professional boxing historically thrived by monetizing major events through closed-circuit broadcasts, premium cable, and pay-per-view. However, the sport ultimately suffered due to political red tape, promotional greed, and top fighters avoiding elite competition to protect their brands. This systemic decline led to waning profits, underwhelming super fights, and major television networks eventually abandoning the sport entirely.

stories.title: Former TNA Champion Debuts for MLW
stories.tldr: Major League Wrestling held a set of Fusion TV tapings in Charleston, South Carolina, featuring several surprise appearances and title changes. While Tessa Blanchard was pulled from the event following scheduling disputes with CMLL, former TNA Knockouts World Champion Masha Slamovich made a surprise debut. Slamovich capitalized on the opportunity by defeating Shotzi Blackheart to capture the MLW Women's World Championship. Additionally, the event featured the conclusion of the 2026 Opera Cup, where Austin Aries defeated Matt Riddle in the tournament finals.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff Criticizes Viability of Tag Team Wrestling
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Eric Bischoff recently argued on his podcast that tag team wrestling is financially inefficient and makes storytelling difficult because it doubles talent costs compared to singles matches. While WWE has historically de-emphasized the division for these exact economic reasons, promotions like AEW continue to invest heavily in tag and trios teams. Bischoff acknowledged that while it does not make financial sense, Tony Khan may simply be operating under different priorities by maintaining a deep tag team roster.

stories.title: Priscilla Kelly and Abadon Comedy Wrestling Spot Goes Viral
stories.tldr: Priscilla Kelly, formerly known in WWE as Gigi Dolin, recently went viral alongside fellow wrestler Abadon for a controversial comedy wrestling spot performed at Lucha Libre and Laughs. Shared by Abadon on social media with the caption a little stank never hurt anyone, the video quickly amassed nearly 917,000 views and sparked a massive online debate. While some fans defended the sequence as harmless comedy wrestling, severe critics attacked the content as disgusting and argued that such spots harm the reputation and pay of women in the industry.

stories.title: TJP Challenges Jordan Cruz at UWN Sunday Night Slam
stories.tldr: Former cruiserweight star TJP is set to challenge Jordan Cruz for the United World Championship at the upcoming United Wrestling Network event, Sunday Night Slam. The card, taking place on September 13 at Thunder Studios in Long Beach, California, features a total of four championship matches. Fans in attendance will also witness Big Mama defending the women’s title against Bryn Thorne, alongside tag team and television title bouts. Tickets for the live event start at an affordable ten dollars with doors opening in the late afternoon.

stories.title: WWE and AAA Relationship and Potential Talent Signings
stories.tldr: Following TripleMania 34, attention is turning toward potential roster additions like Richard Holliday and Anthony Bowens, while Elijah Holyfield has been confirmed to join AAA under The Undertaker. Rey Mysterio recently praised Undertaker for successfully blending WWE-style storytelling with traditional lucha libre. Mysterio also discussed his future in the industry, sharing several major milestones he hopes to accomplish before eventually retiring.

stories.title: Mustafa Ali Teases TNA Wrestling Return Date
stories.tldr: Mustafa Ali has officially fueled speculation about his upcoming TNA return by releasing a video on social media featuring the specific date of September 24, 2026. The new footage confirms his targeted comeback show in San Antonio, Texas, following a brutal recovery period. Additional details reveal that his severe rib and lung injuries stemmed from a routine move rather than the high-impact cage dive previously assumed.

stories.title: AEW Announces Date and Location for Blood & Guts 2026
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has officially announced the date and location for the 2026 edition of Blood and Guts. The violent double-ring steel cage special will take place on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at the VyStar Veterans Memorial Arena in Jacksonville, Florida. This event marks a return to the city where the inaugural concept debuted back in 2021. Tickets for the upcoming television special are scheduled to go on sale to the general public on September 28.

stories.title: Kevin Knight Discusses What The Don Callis Family Needs in AEW
stories.tldr: AEW star Kevin Knight recently discussed the composition of the Don Callis Family and believes the prominent stable is currently missing a crucial element. Having joined the group earlier in June, Knight feels that adding female talent would help balance the heavy testosterone and constant infighting among the nearly fifteen male members. He specifically named Red Velvet and Queen Aminata as potential additions who could bring great energy and fire to the faction.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher Explains Decision Behind AEW International Title Design
stories.tldr: Former AEW International Champion Kyle Fletcher recently explained why he chose not to customize his title belt with a pink design, unlike his previous TNT Championship run. During a recent interview, Fletcher admitted his decision was purely driven by a desire to playfully rebel against fans and officials who pressured him into making changes in the past. Despite losing the championship to Kazuchika Okada at All In London 2026, Fletcher remains heavily involved in high-profile tag team action and growing tensions within The Don Callis Family.

stories.title: Kevin Knight Reflects on AEW Match Against Kenny Omega
stories.tldr: Rising star Kevin Knight recently reflected on his high profile AEW World Championship match against Kenny Omega at AEW Redemption, viewing it as a major sign of trust from Tony Khan and the company. Knight noted the heavy responsibility of delivering a great performance while taking care of a veteran opponent like Omega, who was close to headlining All In against Will Ospreay. Following this massive main event, Knight engaged in a brutal feud with Darby Allin that culminated in a wild Falls Count Anywhere match at All In. That grueling encounter ultimately ended Knight's impressive 140 day TNT Championship reign after a series of devastating spots involving a lighting rig and a stretcher.

stories.title: AEW 2026 Pay-Per-View Schedule Overview
stories.tldr: The 2026 AEW pay-per-view schedule features a lineup of major events spanning the latter half of the year, including All Out, WrestleDream, and Full Gear. Fans can access these broadcasts through a wide variety of streaming services and traditional cable or satellite outlets. Additional major events like Revolution, Dynasty, Double or Nothing, Forbidden Door, Redemption, and All In also form part of the broader 2026 coverage landscape.

stories.title: AEW Exploring Event Plans for WWE WrestleMania 43 Weekend
stories.tldr: AEW is reportedly planning to run its Revolution pay-per-view on the Saturday of WWE WrestleMania 43 weekend in April 2027. While WWE is taking WrestleMania 43 to Saudi Arabia for the first time outside the U.S., AEW does not plan to run its Saturday event in a stadium. Meanwhile, independent promoters, convention organizers, WrestleCon, and Starrcast are already looking to capitalize on the major destination weekend by planning surrounding events.

stories.title: AEW Collision Tribute and Butcher Battle Royal for 'The Butcher' Andy Williams
stories.tldr: Following earlier commentary and graphic tributes, the September 12 episode of AEW Collision served as a full tribute event dedicated to the late Andy The Butcher Williams. Daniel Garcia won the night's Butcher Battle Royal, securing a $100,000 donation for MusiCares in Williams' honor. Additionally, Tony Khan and agent Steve Kaye revealed that Williams had been actively discussing a future backstage role with AEW prior to his passing.

stories.title: Rebel Advocates for ALS Petition Following AEW Rebel Heart Dynamite Reaction
stories.tldr: Backstage reactions to the Rebel Heart edition of Dynamite were overwhelmingly positive, with friends and colleagues praising the event as a complete success that reflected Tanea Rebel Brooks' exact wishes. Numerous wrestling veterans and personalities traveled to Athens, Georgia, to support the tribute show, which coincided with Brooks' continued grassroots advocacy. She is urging fans to sign the ACT for ALS petition before it heads to Congress to prevent dangerous delays in crucial research funding.

stories.title: Kenny Omega Shares Mindset for Big Matches Following Will Ospreay Loss
stories.tldr: Following his high-profile match against Will Ospreay, Kenny Omega has opened up about his creative mindset for marquee AEW bouts. Omega explained that he focuses on making the overall match strong rather than self-preservation, while also praising referees Paul Turner and Rick Knox. He additionally reflected on passing the torch to Ospreay and expressed relief that their major encounter went off without a hitch.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Shares Insights on AEW All In: London Entrance Video
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay recently shared behind-the-scenes secrets about his emotional entrance video at Wembley Stadium. He revealed that his mother provided the narration after some coaching to make it more personal. The iconic use of The Who was actually a last-minute backup choice suggested by a producer, inspired by a similar narrated entrance at Forbidden Door featuring his wife.

stories.title: Blake Monroe Addresses Delayed WWE SmackDown Debut and Mouth Surgery After Giulia Attack
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe is addressing the ongoing delay of her WWE SmackDown in-ring debut by asking fans for patience and explaining that timing is everything. Her anticipated matches against Giulia have repeatedly fallen apart, culminating in a brutal brawl on a recent episode of the show where Monroe suffered severe facial trauma, scratches, and lost teeth. Monroe subsequently announced she requires mouth surgery and even handed a small bag containing her knocked-out teeth to General Manager Nick Aldis in a widely discussed digital exclusive segment.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez Reveals Early AAA Training and Desires Match to Retire AJ Lee
stories.tldr: WWE star Roxanne Perez recently revealed that AAA invited her to train and wrestle at age 16, an opportunity she missed at the time due to her age and parents. Now poised to take over the promotion, she recently earned a AAA Reina de Reinas title shot for an upcoming event. Furthermore, Perez has made it clear she wants a match against her idol AJ Lee and hopes to be the one to officially retire her. AJ Lee has previously stated she would return for the right story, giving Perez a ready-made feud if the opportunity ever arises.

stories.title: JBL Comments on John Cena's Title Record and TKO WWE Pay Structure
stories.tldr: Wrestling Hall of Famer JBL recently shared his thoughts on two major topics during an episode of Something to Wrestle With. First, he stated that Randy Orton has a realistic chance to tie or break John Cena's record of 17 world championships, noting that Orton is currently in phenomenal shape at 14 reigns. Second, JBL defended the TKO WWE pay structure and executive Mark Shapiro's comments regarding resized talent compensation following major media rights deals. He argued that WWE operates as a business with a finite revenue pool, meaning wrestlers who want higher pay must increase their market value by drawing ratings and creating fan interest.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Discusses World Title Ambitions and Hair vs. Hair Match Pitches
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green recently reflected on her unexpected rise to capturing a top women's championship in WWE after previously doubting she would ever hold a world title. She admitted that she long ago stopped setting strict career goals because she realized she could not control her creative direction. Additionally, Green revealed that she actively pitched a hair versus hair match against Nikki Bella for WrestleMania where she would willingly lose her hair. She also discussed her desire to elevate secondary titles like the United States Championship to make them as prestigious as the world championship.

stories.title: AAA Wrestlers Train at WWE Performance Center and Join Meet & Greet Event
stories.tldr: Several wrestlers from the Mexican promotion AAA recently traveled to the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida, to receive coaching on the traditional WWE in-ring style. Although specific names were mostly kept under wraps, Mr. Iguana confirmed his participation through social media. This developmental crossover coincides with major weekend events for AAA, including TripleMania 34. Additionally, WWE and AAA are collaborating on a major fan meet and greet event in Mexico City featuring prominent stars from both promotions.

stories.title: Corey Graves Details Pre-Match Habits of Top WWE Stars
stories.tldr: WWE commentator Corey Graves recently discussed a crucial pre-match habit practiced by the company's biggest names. He revealed that top-tier stars like John Cena, AJ Styles, and Roman Reigns consistently communicate with the commentary team before hitting the ring. Graves explained that sharing their desired match stories allows announcers to enhance the narrative and save segments when things go wrong. Despite the obvious benefits, he noted that the overall number of talents who actually take the time to do this remains remarkably low.

stories.title: WWE Star Expected to Rejoin Faction on Raw
stories.tldr: With factions playing an increasingly prominent role on Monday Night Raw, speculation is growing about WWE stars potentially reuniting with their former stables. The current landscape highlights three major names who could make a dramatic return to their past groups. These potential reunions involve Damian Priest, Chad Gable, and Solo Sikoa potentially rejoining The Judgment Day, Alpha Academy, and The Bloodline respectively.

stories.title: WWE Money In The Bank 2026 Event Schedule Changes
stories.tldr: The 2026 WWE Money in the Bank event is shifting from its traditional summer slot to take place on October 10. Beyond the calendar change, the company has opportunities to shake up the event's formula by expanding the ladder match fields, involving NXT talent in the qualifiers, and potentially booking the first-ever failed women's cash-in. These adjustments could bring fresh excitement and unpredictability to one of the most anticipated premium live events of the year.

stories.title: Overview of Factions Currently Active on WWE NXT
stories.tldr: WWE NXT and the Evolve brand currently feature several active stables and factions showcasing multi-generational stars, developmental prospects, and championship contenders. Groups like BirthRight, DarkState, The Dungeon, and The Vanity Project populate the NXT landscape, while stables such as Lyons Group and The MOG Squad operate primarily within Evolve. A proven developmental pathway allows top talent from Evolve, including champions from The Vanity Project, to eventually transition to full-time NXT contracts.

stories.title: The Rock's Live-Action Moana Released on Digital Platforms
stories.tldr: Dwayne The Rock Johnson stars as the demigod Maui in the new live-action adaptation of Moana, which has officially arrived on digital storefronts. Directed by Thomas Kail and co-starring Catherine Lagaia as Moana, the 2026 film follows the titular character on a voyage beyond Motunui's reef. Fans can now purchase the movie digitally with special bonus features, ahead of its upcoming physical Blu-ray release in October.

stories.title: Overview of Active Factions on WWE Raw
stories.tldr: Factions remain a core component of WWE programming, driving major storylines across Raw, SmackDown, and NXT. Dominant groups like The Bloodline and The Judgment Day anchor the brand, while newer or shifting stables like The Vision, American Made, and the 946 add fresh dynamics. International partnerships with AAA also feature prominently, with groups like Los Americanos and the Latino World Order regularly crossing over.

stories.title: Becky Lynch Reflects on Her Time in WWE NXT Promo Classes
stories.tldr: Becky Lynch recently reflected on her early days in WWE NXT during a media appearance, specifically highlighting the chaotic and creative environment of the weekly promo classes. She described these sessions as a talent show where developmental wrestlers could experiment with wild character ideas without fear of failure. Lynch noted that this fearless experimentation helped stars like LA Knight, Sasha Banks, and Bayley develop the personas that eventually made them famous on television.

stories.title: JBL Reveals Commentary Was Kept in Dark Over WrestleMania Finish
stories.tldr: Former WWE wrestler and commentator JBL recently revealed that the commentary team was completely unaware of the finish to The Undertaker and Brock Lesnar's historic match at WrestleMania 30. According to JBL speaking on Something to Wrestle, even play-by-play announcer Michael Cole was preparing to call the continuation of the legendary undefeated streak before being genuinely shocked by the outcome. While commentators are usually briefed on match outcomes to better guide their storytelling, they did not ask for this finish and were left stunned by the historic moment. JBL admitted he felt a twinge of sadness and thought the end of the streak felt like the end of an era, though he ultimately agreed that Lesnar was the right person to finally defeat The Undertaker.

stories.title: Flashback to Vince McMahon Being Attacked by Kevin Owens on SmackDown
stories.tldr: This September 2017 flashback looks back at the memorable SmackDown moment when a 72 year old Vince McMahon took a brutal headbutt from Kevin Owens to build up their upcoming Hell in a Cell match against Shane McMahon. The angle famously featured McMahon bleeding heavily on television, directly contradicting the company public ban on blading and family friendly content policies at the time. Wrestling Observer Newsletter reports highlighted the dramatic physical toll of the segment, drawing comparisons to a notorious hardway headbutt from New Japan Pro Wrestling that had recently ended Katsuyori career.

stories.title: Dexter Lumis Discusses Playing a Non-Verbal Character
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Samuel Shaw recently discussed the unique challenge of playing the entirely non-verbal Dexter Lumis character during his time with the company. Speaking on INSIGHT with Chris Van Vliet, Shaw explained that while his earlier TNA gimmick was soft-spoken, WWE opted to make the character completely silent. He embraced this creative direction as a way to stand out in a world where he felt people talked too much, turning the silent stare into a masterclass in non-verbal storytelling.

stories.title: AJ Styles Praises Rey Mysterio as the GOAT of Lucha Libre
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently praised WWE Hall of Famer Rey Mysterio as the GOAT of lucha libre ahead of Mysterio's high-profile match against Omos at TripleMania 34. Styles noted that while Omos possesses an extreme size advantage at seven feet three inches tall, Mysterio's decades of experience against heavyweights made him well-prepared for the clash. The rivalry between Mysterio and Omos stemmed from an indefinite suspension issued by Mysterio in his role as AAA General Manager after Omos attacked another wrestler and chokeslammed Mysterio. Ultimately, Omos defeated Mysterio in the main event of TripleMania 34 Night One at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Paradise, Nevada.

stories.title: Awesome Kong Recalls Her Path to Signing With WWE
stories.tldr: Former TNA star Awesome Kong recently recalled how WWE unexpectedly reached out to her in 2010 after leaving her previous promotion, despite years of peers telling her that Vince McMahon would never hire someone like her. Kong bypassed developmental and debuted on the main roster as Kharma in 2011, eventually making a historic appearance in the 2012 Men's Royal Rumble before departing later that year. Now retired at age 49, Kong remains grateful for the short-lived run and has left the door open for a potential one-off return under the right circumstances.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez Addresses Judgment Day Dynamics and Money in the Bank Plans
stories.tldr: Roxanne Perez recently discussed her loyalty to The Judgment Day and dismissed rumors that she would betray stablemates Liv Morgan and Raquel Rodriguez if she wins the women's Money in the Bank briefcase. Reflecting on her past trauma from being backstabbed by former tag team partner Cora Jade, now known as Elayna Black, Perez emphasized that she values her faction sisters and has spent the last year and a half proving her dedication. Additionally, she addressed ongoing internal tension within the group, comparing it to normal family squabbles rather than a sign of imminent collapse.

stories.title: Kevin Nash Reflects on Missing Opportunity to Face Late WWE Star
stories.tldr: During a recent podcast appearance, wrestling legend Kevin Nash reflected on his 1995 WWE Championship run as Diesel and his underwhelming SummerSlam match against King Mabel. Nash revealed that he would have much rather defended his title against the late Bam Bam Bigelow, believing they could have torn the house down if Bigelow had been booked as a stronger heel. Bigelow unfortunately passed away in 2007 after a storied career spanning multiple major promotions across the globe.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa Names Dream AEW Opponents for Long-Term Feuds
stories.tldr: Tommaso Ciampa recently revealed his top dream opponents for extended six-month programs in All Elite Wrestling. Speaking on a recent podcast appearance, the former TNT Champion designated MJF and Jon Moxley as his 1A and 1B choices for deeply layered, long-lasting feuds. Ciampa highlighted their exceptional capabilities both on the microphone and inside the ring as the primary reasons for wanting to battle them.

stories.title: Brooks Jensen Explains How He Formed Friendship With AJ Styles
stories.tldr: WWE star Brooks Jensen recently explained how his friendship with AJ Styles began during the pandemic when a local promoter arranged for them to train together. To make the trip possible, an 18-year-old Jensen had to borrow a car and drive two and a half hours to meet the wrestling legend. Styles now speaks very highly of the young talent, predicting that Jensen is destined to become one of the biggest stars to emerge from NXT.

stories.title: Trish Stratus Scheduled to Appear at GrandeCon
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus is scheduled to make a special appearance at GrandeCon in Grande Prairie, Alberta, this weekend on September 12 and 13. Fans attending the event at the Bonnetts Energy Centre can look forward to a main-stage Q and A panel on Saturday afternoon followed by dedicated photo sessions across the weekend. Single-day admission passes are currently available for purchase, though they do not include individual autographs or photo ops. Attendees are advised to check the official organizer schedule as event timings remain subject to change.

stories.title: Sami Zayn Defeats CM Punk to Win Undisputed WWE Championship on SmackDown
stories.tldr: Following his chaotic victory over CM Punk to become a two-time Undisputed WWE Champion on SmackDown, Sami Zayn faced heavy hostility from the live crowd in Mexico City. CM Punk has since broken his silence on social media, reflecting on his 67-day title reign and vowing to get his championship back. Meanwhile, the surprising title change has sparked heavy discussion regarding upcoming challenger pictures and potential roster shifts across the company.

stories.title: Stephanie Vaquer Wins WWE Women's World Championship at Live Event in Chile
stories.tldr: At the live event in Santiago, Chile, Stephanie Vaquer defeated Liv Morgan to capture her second WWE Women's World Championship. Special guest referee Becky Lynch intentionally cost Morgan the match by refusing to count to three and flipping her off, ending Morgan's 148-day title reign. Vaquer capitalized with the SVB and Vaquer Inferno to secure the emotional home-country victory. Lynch later took to social media to mock Morgan, while Triple H celebrated the major title change.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio Wants WWE Match and Moment with Children Dominik and Aalyah Before Retiring
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Rey Mysterio hopes to share the ring with both Dominik and Aalyah before retiring, creating a historic family moment. He is also open to eventually revisiting his feud with Dominik, comparing their dynamic to legendary movie franchises like Rocky. Meanwhile, Rey is taking a relaxed approach to his retirement timeline while balancing his active schedule and his duties as a AAA general manager.

stories.title: Bronson Reed Prepares for Oba Femi Rivalry Following Return to WWE TV
stories.tldr: Following his explosive return to WWE television and attacks on Oba Femi, Bronson Reed is elaborating on his upcoming rivalry by comparing his in-ring style to Brock Lesnar. Reed claims to be more gritty and dangerous than Lesnar, promising to push Femi to his absolute limits. Backstage reports indicate that officials are thrilled with Reed's current physical condition, and a tense physical exchange between Reed and Femi on Raw was completely unscripted.

stories.title: Je'Von Evans Discusses Working With Brock Lesnar and Oba Femi in WWE
stories.tldr: JeVon Evans recently expanded on his unforgettable Royal Rumble encounter with Brock Lesnar, noting that the F5 was surprisingly smooth while the suplex could have been disastrous if he had not heeded backstage advice. Evans also shared insights into his NXT rivalry with Oba Femi, admitting he was initially intimidated by Femi's deep voice. The two powerhouse talents ultimately built incredible in-ring chemistry by trusting each other's creativity and occasionally trading stiff shots.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio Responds to Fans Requesting a Bigger WWE Push
stories.tldr: Dominik Mysterio is addressing fan concerns about his positioning on Raw by asking supporters to remain patient. Amid reports of backstage frustration regarding his booking compared to his success outside the company, the star emphasized his long-term career outlook. Mysterio reminded fans that he is still developing and has plenty of time ahead of him.

stories.title: Update on WWE Talent Pulled From Match After Injury Scare
stories.tldr: Following the Triplemanía 34 injury scare that temporarily paused the opening match, there is positive news regarding Lady Shani's health. Sources report that she is doing well and has shown no signs of a concussion. Attention now shifts to Mexico City for the heavily stacked second night of the event.

stories.title: Tease of Next Member to Leave WWE's Judgment Day Faction
stories.tldr: Following recent speculation about potential new recruits for an evolving Judgment Day stable, attention has turned to which current members might be heading for the exit. Reports indicate that Dominik Mysterio is growing frustrated with his comedic main roster booking compared to his serious success in AAA, making a departure and potential solo run a distinct possibility. Additionally, long-term friction could finally boil over between Liv Morgan and Roxanne Perez, setting the stage for Perez to break away from the faction.

stories.title: Damian Priest Sets Future WWE Plans After Turning Heel on SmackDown
stories.tldr: Following his shocking heel turn on R-Truth in Mexico City, Damian Priest is looking ahead to a refreshed run as a villain on the WWE main roster. Analysts suggest his immediate future could involve a short program against Truth to solidify his new attitude, a potential AAA Mega Championship pursuit in Mexico, or a strategic move to Monday Night Raw. These new directions aim to revitalize Priest following a plateau in his babyface run.

stories.title: Grayson Waller Comments on His WWE NXT Championship Run
stories.tldr: Grayson Waller previously revealed that Shawn Michaels personally asked him to anchor WWE NXT, brushing off claims of a career demotion while setting his sights on CM Punk. Expanding on that mindset, the newly crowned champion has now dubbed his current run a redemption season dedicated to restoring the brand's prestigious black and gold era. He has boldly declared that no one on the current roster can take the title from him, completely dismissing a recent crop of contenders following their latest matches.

stories.title: John Cena Recalls Scrapped Plans for WWE Heel Turn
stories.tldr: Long before his recent villainous transformation, John Cena was nearly turned heel a decade earlier under Vince McMahon. Speaking at a recent convention, Cena revealed he went as far as recording new music and ordering gear for a planned heel turn during his feud with Dwayne Johnson before McMahon abruptly scrapped it. That historical brush with a dark persona showcased the extreme preparation Cena relied on when his real-life character shift finally materialized years later.

stories.title: Joe Gacy Shares Thoughts on Joining WWE's Wyatt Sicks Faction
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Joe Gacy recently detailed how he was secretly recruited into the Wyatt Sicks while still in NXT. He explained that the original creative pitch involved Bo Dallas using a split personality and trauma to convince lost wrestlers to portray his puppet characters, including Gacy as Huskus the Pig Boy. Although this storyline was never fully explored on television, Gacy noted that the members formed a genuine, tight-knit family in real life.

stories.title: WWE 2026 Premium Live Event Schedule Overview
stories.tldr: Specific dates, venues, and broadcast details for WWE's late 2026 premium live event schedule have now been revealed. The upcoming run features major stops in Chicago, New Orleans, Saudi Arabia, Houston, and Perth between September and December. Domestically, fans can watch these broadcasts on ESPN Unlimited, while international viewers will stream them on Netflix.

stories.title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event International Viewership Update
stories.tldr: Following its eventful live broadcast in Atlanta, new figures reveal that the special drew limited international viewership. Peacock will not release official domestic numbers, while international streaming relied largely on YouTube outside of India. Peak global YouTube viewership reached roughly 120,000, highlighting low overseas engagement similar to past television specials.

stories.title: Zuffa Boxing Event Features Ryan Garcia Victory and WWE Cameos
stories.tldr: The recent Zuffa Boxing event at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas featured major crossover moments between the worlds of boxing and professional wrestling. Ryan Garcia secured a dominant second-round TKO victory over Conor Benn with WWE star Rey Mysterio accompanying him to the ring. Meanwhile, WWE Chief Content Officer Triple H caught fans attention in the crowd by debuting a surprising new hairstyle. Additional wrestling flavor was on display when boxer Mark Magsayo walked out to Cody Rhodes famous Kingdom entrance theme.

stories.title: Gisele Shaw Signs Contract With NWA
stories.tldr: Former TNA Wrestling star Gisele Shaw has officially signed an exclusive contract with the National Wrestling Alliance. The major acquisition was announced by NWA President William Patrick Billy Corgan during an episode of NWA Powerrr. Shaw currently holds the NWA Women's World Television Championship, which she won by defeating Tiffany Nieves at the 2026 Crockett Cup. In addition to her ongoing NWA commitments, she continues to compete in other promotions, including defending her MLP Women's Canadian Championship.

stories.title: AMAKUSA Pulled From NOAH Action Due to Medical Abnormality
stories.tldr: Pro Wrestling NOAH has sidelined three-time GHC Junior Heavyweight Champion AMAKUSA after a routine medical checkup revealed an undisclosed abnormality. Due to this precautionary measure, his scheduled September 15th GHC National Championship match against Naomichi Marufuji has been canceled. Although he is unable to compete, AMAKUSA is still scheduled to appear at the venue to greet fans while he remains out of action.

stories.title: Mustafa Ali Scheduled to Return on TNA iMPACT
stories.tldr: Mustafa Ali is scheduled to make his in-ring return on the September 24 episode of TNA iMPACT live from San Antonio, Texas. Ali has been out of action since suffering severe injuries, including fractured ribs and a punctured lung, during his Cage match victory against Jason Hotch at the Lockdown pay-per-view. Ahead of his comeback, tensions have already escalated regarding his TNA International Championship, highlighted by a recent no-contest match interfered with by his Order 4 faction stablemate, Agent Zero. Ali recently shared a promotional hype video on social media with the caption indicating the severity of his recent medical ordeal.

stories.title: Leon Slater Responds to Grayson Waller's Criticism of TNA
stories.tldr: TNA rising star Leon Slater has strongly responded to recent critical remarks made by WWE NXT star Grayson Waller regarding TNA Wrestling. Waller has mocked TNA on multiple occasions, comparing its roster to being the best in a high school gym, which prompted Slater to dismiss the comments as mere talk done for clicks and views. Slater challenged Waller to step into a TNA ring and repeat those insults to the faces of talent like Frankie Kazarian and Nic Nemeth. Furthermore, Slater expressed full interest in facing Waller directly, noting his own prior success working matches on the WWE side.

stories.title: Gangrel and Al Snow Action Figures Announced for Preorder
stories.tldr: Hasttel Toy and Collectibles has announced new officially licensed Regium action figures featuring wrestling veterans Gangrel and Al Snow, available now for preorder. Each figure is priced at $54.99, with a discounted two-figure bundle offered at $99.99, and all orders include free U.S. shipping. The modern-style, articulated collectibles come with various interchangeable parts and accessories, such as a fabric shirt for Gangrel. Scheduled to ship in the first quarter of 2027, these items are marketed as adult collectibles for ages 18 and older with final designs subject to change from the prototypes.

stories.title: D'Lo Brown and Priscilla Kelly Announced for MLP London Fan Experience
stories.tldr: Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling has announced that D Lo Brown and Priscilla Kelly will headline a two day fan experience at London Comic Con in Ontario. The September event features live matches, talent Q and As, and a cosplay competition where the winner scores sold out show tickets. Admission is included with general convention passes, with proceeds also supporting the Childrens Health Foundation.

stories.title: Killer Kross vs. Matt Riddle Match Set for WrestlePro Event
stories.tldr: Killer Kross is scheduled to defend his ACW World Heavyweight Championship against Matt Riddle at an upcoming WrestlePro event. The show, titled Kross The Line, will also feature a historic women's ladder match for the WrestlePro Women's Championship between champion Rebecca Scott and challenger Lady Frost. Originally set for October 3, the event has been moved to Sunday, October 4, at the Rahway Rec Center in New Jersey due to scheduling and talent availability. Tickets for the original date will automatically transfer, and refunds are available through Eventbrite for those unable to attend the new date.

stories.title: Ron Simmons Reflects on Historic WCW World Title Victory
stories.tldr: Ron Simmons recently looked back on his historic August 1992 WCW World Heavyweight Championship victory over Vader during a podcast appearance. He revealed that the monumental title change was kept secret from almost everyone until moments before it happened at a house show. Simmons admitted he initially did not grasp the profound cultural impact the win would have, though he now regularly receives letters from fans of all backgrounds who were inspired by the milestone.

stories.title: Corey Graves Compares AAA Wrestling Style to Savannah Bananas
stories.tldr: WWE commentator Corey Graves recently compared the Mexican lucha libre promotion AAA to the Savannah Bananas baseball team during an OutKick interview. Graves explained that while AAA retains the core elements of traditional wrestling, it presents them through an entertaining lens focused on pageantry, characters, and high-energy action. He noted that this unique style appeals to audiences who might not enjoy standard programming, much like how the Savannah Bananas attract fans to a modernized version of baseball. The comments arrive as AAA holds its major TripleMania 34 event spanning Las Vegas and Mexico City.

stories.title: Takeshita and Minoru Suzuki Set for DDT Anniversary Event
stories.tldr: DDT Pro-Wrestling has announced a star-studded lineup featuring Konosuke Takeshita and Minoru Suzuki for Yuki Ueno's tenth-anniversary event, titled IN MY MIND 10, at Korakuen Hall. Ueno will headline the September 13 show in a singles match against Shunma Katsumata, while Takeshita and Suzuki are featured in separate high-profile bouts. Fans in the United States can catch the live broadcast on Wrestle Universe, with the main card kicking off late Saturday night due to the time zone difference.

stories.title: Matt Riddle vs. Brick Savage Set to Main Event MLW Fusion
stories.tldr: Major League Wrestling has announced that Matt Riddle will square off against Brick Savage in the upcoming main event of MLW Fusion. Savage enters the match as the newest recruit for the CONTRA Unit under the guidance of Josef Samael. In addition to the marquee showdown, the broadcast will feature the beginning of the 2026 Opera Cup with two opening-round tournament matches. Fans can catch the action across multiple platforms and broadcast times throughout the weekend and into the following week.

stories.title: Lady Shani Injury Update Following AAA TripleMania 34
stories.tldr: Following her early exit from Triplemanía 34 due to a suspected face injury, there is now positive news regarding Lady Shani. Backstage reports indicate she is currently doing well and showing no concussion symptoms. She was pulled from the mixed six-person tag team match as a precaution and did not return to the bout.

stories.title: Metrics Analysis for AAA Triplemania 34 Night 1
stories.tldr: Following the kickoff of Triplemania 34 in Las Vegas, early streaming metrics show strong numbers for the event across digital platforms. The English-language broadcast on the WWE YouTube channel and the Spanish-language stream on the AAA channel combined for roughly 1.18 million views in its first 15 hours. Additionally, US Google Search interest for AAA is up 60 percent compared to last year, highlighting growing domestic reach despite a slight dip in Mexico.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Historical Match Highlights for September 12
stories.tldr: Moving to September 12, the historical focus shifts to acclaimed matches primarily based in Japan according to Cagematch ratings. The top-rated match on this date is El Desperado facing Jun Kasai in JTO from 2022, which earned a 4.75-star rating from the Wrestling Observer Newsletter. Other notable entries in the top ten span promotions like Pro Wrestling NOAH, New Japan Pro Wrestling, Dragongate, and WWE.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Historical Title Changes for September 12
stories.tldr: Shifting from September 11 to the following day, September 12 boasts a historical ledger of 257 major professional wrestling title changes. Notable shifts on this date span decades, featuring legendary victories by Sting in 1999 and Triple H in 2004, alongside modern milestones like Becky Lynch's 2023 NXT Women's Championship win and Dominik Mysterio claiming the AAA Mega Title in 2025.

stories.title: Triangle of Madness Defends Artist of Stardom Championship
stories.tldr: Triangle of Madness successfully retained their Artist of Stardom Championships against Natsupoi, Aya Sakura, and Yuna Mizumori at the Yokohama Budokan event. Skye Blue secured the victory using the title belt behind the referee's back before hitting a TKO on Sakura. Following the match, Hazuki, Koguma, and Fuwa-chan confronted the champions to demand a title shot and the return of the belts.

stories.title: Keith Lee Resurfaces on Social Media, Sparking Fan Discussion
stories.tldr: Former AEW star Keith Lee has resurfaced on social media for the first time in nearly a year by sharing a photo with consciousness explorer Darius J. Wright. Lee has not wrestled since December 2023 due to health issues and personal struggles, with industry reports indicating that he is likely retired. His heavy promotion of Wright and the AYDA spiritual program has sparked immediate concern and accusations from fans online that he has joined a cult. Lee has not publicly addressed his wrestling future, the retirement speculation, or the backlash regarding his new path.

stories.title: Mick Foley and Rob Schamberger Release Limited Art Print on ShopAEW
stories.tldr: Wrestling legend Mick Foley and acclaimed artist Rob Schamberger have collaborated on a new collector item featuring a hand-numbered art print. Priced at $75, the 11-by-14-inch print is limited to just 50 signed copies and is currently available on ShopAEW. The release marks Schamberger's first Foley painting for the wrestling promotion and ships flat in a protective toploader.

stories.title: Jazwares Unveils New AEW Exclusive Action Figures
stories.tldr: Jazwares has announced three new AEW exclusive action figures featuring top wrestling stars Kazuchika Okada, Swerve Strickland, and Owen Hart. Available for preorder exclusively through Ringside Collectibles, these figures range in price from $34.99 to $49.99 and feature distinct accessories like entrance robes, hoodies, and alternate head options.
