Collectors can expect delivery between early and mid-December, though shipping estimates remain subject to change and final licensor approval.

stories.title: Persephone Discusses Testing Waters of Partnership with Britt Baker and AEW
stories.tldr: CMLL World Women's Champion Persephone recently won the TBS Championship at AEW All In London 2026 with assistance from the returning Britt Baker, forming a new on-screen alliance. In a recent interview, Persephone described her partnership with Baker as an interesting experiment involving two strong personalities and big egos. While she is historically accustomed to competing individually due to her Olympic wrestling background, she and Baker are currently testing the waters to see if their pairing will thrive or clash.

stories.title: AEW Stars Announced for Upcoming All Elite Comedy Show
stories.tldr: RJ City and Colt Cabana are set to host the next All Elite Comedy show in Chicago on Friday, September 25. The sold-out Pro Wrestling Tees presentation features a lineup including Harley Cameron, Megan Bayne, Glacier, Lena Kross, and Daniel Garcia. Taking place at the Lincoln Lodge the night before AEW All Out, the 90-minute event offers VIP ticket holders exclusive perks like signed posters and early seating.

stories.title: Reactions and Tributes Following AEW 'Rebel Heart' Dynamite
stories.tldr: Following the emotional Rebel Heart episode of Dynamite, Tanea Rebel Brooks released an urgent video urging fans to support the ACT for ALS petition to secure critical research funding. Meanwhile, Dr. Britt Baker fired back at online criticism from Disco Inferno regarding the placement of Rebel's video package on the broadcast. Critics and commentators also praised the promotion for handling the deeply moving tributes to both Rebel and the late Andy The Butcher Williams.

stories.title: AEW All Out 2026 Ticket Sales and Match Card Updates
stories.tldr: AEW All Out ticket sales have surged to 9,086 distributed, leaving just 10 seats remaining in the current arena setup as the September 26 event approaches. The pay-per-view will go head-to-head with a WWE and AAA Worlds Collide event in the Chicago area. Confirmed matches feature Will Ospreay defending the world title against Jon Moxley, a tag team TLC match, and a women's street fight.

stories.title: Reason Behind Kenny Omega's Absence Ahead of AEW All In
stories.tldr: Kenny Omega was notably absent from the final AEW Dynamite before All In, leaving Will Ospreay to handle the go-home segment alone. Backstage reports indicate that AEW pulled Omega from the broadcast after a pre-show crowd test resulted in Omega getting cheered while Ospreay was unexpectedly booed. Ospreay has since confirmed he heard those boos and briefly considered shifting to a heel persona before ultimately receiving a positive reaction during the live broadcast.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live Discusses 9/11 Memories and Current Wrestling News
stories.tldr: Bryan Alvarez and Lance Storm returned with a packed episode covering personal 9/11 memories and the latest health updates from around the industry. The hosts also addressed the ongoing situation surrounding Keith Lee and Will Ospreay reflecting on being booed by fans in Scotland. Additionally, Alvarez promoted his upcoming independent wrestling matches and scheduled book signings for later this month.

stories.title: Kevin Knight Credits QT Marshall and AR Fox for Career Mentorship
stories.tldr: Expanding on his recent comments about his developmental journey, Kevin Knight recently credited QT Marshall and AR Fox with helping build his professional wrestling career from the ground up. Knight explained that both veterans assisted him in learning the business and cultivating his on-screen persona. He also highlighted how growing up in Atlanta helped shape his unique, larger-than-life character now seen on television.

stories.title: WWE Reportedly Pitching Tag Team Return Direction for Jordynne Grace and Ivy Nile
stories.tldr: WWE has reportedly pitched a new creative direction to pair absent main roster stars Jordynne Grace and Ivy Nile as a tag team. Neither wrestler has been sidelined due to injury, but both have spent months awaiting proper television utilization. Sources indicate that vignettes for the duo were filmed over the summer with hopes of airing in September, potentially under the trademarked name Iron Built. This move could inject fresh energy into the women's division while providing a major character shift for both athletes.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Interview and Money in the Bank Qualifiers Set for Next SmackDown
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes will return to Friday Night SmackDown next week for a sit-down interview with Michael Cole following his recent loss to Randy Orton at Sunday Night Main Event. The upcoming September 18 episode in Corpus Christi, Texas, will also feature continuing qualifying matches for the men and women Money in the Bank ladder matches. Meanwhile, the championship landscape has shifted dramatically with Sami Zayn capturing the Undisputed WWE Championship from CM Punk. A WWE Hall of Famer has also weighed in, suggesting that Rhodes should snap and go off the deep end in response to Orton actions.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio Discusses Classic Entrance Theme and Aalyah's WWE Training
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Rey Mysterio is considering bringing back his iconic original theme song and signature pop-up entrance for a final run before retirement. Meanwhile, his daughter Aalyah has officially begun her professional wrestling training at the WWE Performance Center, though she is currently navigating a steep learning curve. Her brother Dominik Mysterio humorously reacted to the news by admitting he never expected her to join the business since she is the smart one with a degree, jokingly telling her to choose between him and their father. Both Rey and Dominik are also gearing up for high-profile matches at upcoming AAA events.

stories.title: Shawn Michaels and Triple H Discuss WWE Tryouts and Tour Plans in Hawaii
stories.tldr: WWE is returning to Hawaii in October for its first live events in years at the Blaisdell Arena alongside a two-day talent tryout. Shawn Michaels expressed his excitement to discover the next generation of Pacific Island stars, highlighting the region's rich history of athletic success and authentic family connections like The Bloodline. Meanwhile, Paul Triple H Levesque emphasized that this trip is not a one-time deal and announced plans to make Hawaii a regular touring destination moving forward.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Famer Fred 'Typhoon' Ottman Hospitalized
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Fred Ottman, known to fans as Typhoon, Tugboat, and The Shockmaster, has been hospitalized following an emergency room visit for an undisclosed medical issue. The hospitalization forced the 70-year-old wrestling veteran to cancel his scheduled appearance at the SWFL Super Card Show in Fort Myers, Florida. Ottman shared a video message from his hospital bed asking fans to keep him in their thoughts and prayers as he awaits further word from his doctors. This latest health setback follows a serious medical scare earlier this year when Ottman spent a month in the hospital after his gallbladder exploded.

stories.title: WWE Hosts Talent Tryout in Chile During South American Tour
stories.tldr: WWE is hosting a talent tryout in Santiago, Chile, as part of the company's extensive South American tour. Several prominent independent wrestlers from across Latin America have confirmed their participation on social media. The hopefuls hail from countries including Chile, Panama, Brazil, and Argentina, all vying for an opportunity in front of WWE decision-makers.

stories.title: Roman Reigns vs. Oba Femi Reportedly Planned as WrestleMania 43 Main Event in Saudi Arabia
stories.tldr: WWE reportedly has tentative creative plans in place for WrestleMania 43 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, featuring Roman Reigns versus Oba Femi as the Sunday night main event. While a blockbuster match against The Rock was previously discussed, his heavy movie filming schedule makes an in-ring return unlikely. Company leadership has noted that the core creative direction for the historic international event is largely mapped out, though all plans remain subject to change.

stories.title: Samantha Irvin Nearing Expiration of WWE Non-Compete Clause
stories.tldr: Former WWE ring announcer Samantha Irvin is just weeks away from the expiration of her two-year non-compete clause, which concludes next month. Irvin initially left the company in October 2024 to focus on her singing career rather than immediately pursue wrestling elsewhere. Although she has teased potentially working alongside her husband, AEW star Ricochet, there is currently no indication of where she will sign once she is contractually free.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown 9/11/2026 Coverage and Review
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown on September 11, 2026, emanated from the Arena CDMX in Mexico City with a star-studded card featuring multiple high-stakes championship matches. The night was headlined by a shocking WWE Championship change as Sami Zayn defeated CM Punk following the promotion's signature interference finishes. Other notable bouts included Rey Fenix defending the AAA World Cruiserweight Championship against Ricky Saints, while backstage drama featured Damian Priest turning on R-Truth and the continuation of the Trick Williams and Baron Corbin feud.

stories.title: Johnny Gargano Ends Planking Angle and Demands WWE Title Opportunity
stories.tldr: Johnny Gargano has officially ended his bizarre eight month planking angle where he lay face down backstage due to a lack of motivation. After breaking out of his depressed state in his hometown of Cleveland when CM Punk offered him an Undisputed WWE Championship match, Gargano is now being featured more prominently on WWE programming. Following a backstage confrontation on the September 11 episode of SmackDown, Gargano extracted a promise from Sami Zayn that he would receive the first title shot if Zayn defeated Punk. Zayn ultimately captured the championship in the main event following outside interference from Gargano, Candice LeRae, and Kevin Owens, setting the stage for Gargano's pursuit of the gold.

stories.title: Triple H and Lillian Garcia Lead WWE Tributes Marking 25 Years Since 9/11
stories.tldr: WWE marked the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks with a solemn tribute on SmackDown, featuring a moving video narrated by Chief Content Officer Triple H. The broadcast honored the 2,977 victims and highlighted American resilience, incorporating historical footage from the September 13, 2001, episode in Houston. Concurrently, former ring announcer Lilian Garcia reflected on her emotional experience performing the national anthem during that historic post-tragedy broadcast during a recent radio appearance.

stories.title: John Cena Shares Poster for Upcoming Apple TV Film 'Matchbox'
stories.tldr: WWE legend John Cena has shared a new promotional poster for his upcoming action film Matchbox The Movie. The project is scheduled to premiere on October 9 on Apple TV with a PG-13 rating and a runtime of two hours and six minutes. Cena stars as an undercover CIA agent alongside an ensemble cast that includes Jessica Biel and Sam Richardson.

stories.title: Roman Reigns Potential Opponents and Next WWE Title Defense
stories.tldr: World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns faces an array of potential future challengers on Raw following his upcoming title defense against Penta on September 14. WWE has mapped out several fresh first-time singles matches for the Tribal Chief against top stars like GUNTHER, Chad Gable, and Bron Breakker. Additionally, long-term programs and blood feuds involving LA Knight, Solo Sikoa, Bronson Reed, Royce Keys, and Oba Femi are on the horizon. The landscape sets up major marquee matches for upcoming premium live events as Reigns solidifies his place at the head of the table.

stories.title: WWE Files Trademark Application for 'Iron Built'
stories.tldr: WWE recently submitted a trademark application with the United States Patent and Trademark Office for the term Iron Built. Filed on September 10, the application utilizes standard language that suggests the term could be used for a wrestler nickname, catchphrase, or faction on the main roster or NXT. While exact plans remain unannounced, the filing joins a slate of recent intellectual property updates from the company. These recent moves also include trademark filings for 946, Zilla Fatu, and the WWE Vault YouTube channel.

stories.title: Fallon Henley Featured in New Arby's Commercial
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown star Fallon Henley has officially partnered with Arby's for a new social media advertisement promoting the fast-food chain's steak nuggets. This unexpected sponsorship stems from a viral story shared by Cody Rhodes in July on his podcast, where he recalled wrestler Aaron Solo attempting to shoot his shot with Henley. The viral moment previously prompted Arby's to send Henley a gift, which has now blossomed into a full promotional collaboration.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Debuts New Theme Song
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown officially has a new theme song. During the September 11 episode of WWE SmackDown, it was announced that “Let ‘Em Know” by T.I. is now serving as the official theme for the weekly blue brand show. The track is featured on T.I.’s Kill the King album. “Let ‘Em Know” replaces “Neva Play”

stories.title: CM Punk Lands Guest Acting Role on ABC Series
stories.tldr: WWE star CM Punk is expanding his acting resume by securing a guest role in the second season of the ABC series RJ Decker. The episode was recently filmed in Florida, though specific details regarding his character and the exact air date are currently being kept under wraps. The show follows a disgraced newspaper photographer turned private investigator in South Florida as he handles bizarre cases with his associates. Meanwhile, Punk remains active in the ring as he prepares for upcoming championship defenses in his wrestling career.

stories.title: Predicting Women's WarGames Matches for WWE Survivor Series 2026
stories.tldr: WWE Survivor Series WarGames 2026 is approaching on November 28 in Houston, Texas, with early speculation focusing on the potential lineups for the women's cage match. Creative predictions suggest a fascinating mix of veterans and rising stars, including Charlotte Flair, Alexa Bliss, Tatum Paxley, Bayley, and Becky Lynch on one side. Opposing them could be a fierce faction featuring Jade Cargill, B-Fab, Michin, Lyra Valkyria, and Maxxine Dupri, carrying over several intense ongoing feuds. This year also marks the fortieth anniversary of Survivor Series and the fifth year utilizing the WarGames stipulation since its modern integration.

stories.title: Mattel Announces New Production Run for Penta WWE Ultimate Edition Figure
stories.tldr: Mattel has announced a brand new production run for Penta’s highly sought-after WWE Ultimate Edition action figure due to overwhelming demand from collectors and fans. Originally reported by Wrestling Figure News on September 9, the reopened preorders are currently listed at fifty dollars directly through Mattel. Because of the heavy demand and production schedule, buyers should note that these newly ordered figures are not expected to ship until 2027.

stories.title: Kevin Nash Announced for Appearance at Raptor Con
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash is scheduled to appear at Raptor Con in Evansville, Indiana, on September 12 and 13. Nash’s official appearance calendar and the convention’s guest list both confirm the booking. The event takes place at Old National Events Plaza, located at 715 Locust Street. Fans planning to attend Satu

stories.title: Speculation on Former AEW Stars Winning WWE World Championships
stories.tldr: Following the success of former AEW stars like Cody Rhodes and CM Punk capturing world titles in WWE, several other prominent roster members who crossed over are being positioned for similar main event success. Powerhouse Hobbs, now performing as Royce Keys, has quickly transitioned into a top-tier heel role on Raw and is viewed internally as a future world champion. Meanwhile, Penta is receiving a major television opportunity against Roman Reigns to test his potential as WWE's next top Hispanic star, and former AEW standout Mariah May, competing as Blake Monroe, is widely expected to break through on the women's main roster given the right booking.

stories.title: Sgt. Slaughter Live-Action Film in Development
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Sgt. Slaughter, whose real name is Robert Remus, has announced that a live-action movie based on his iconic fictional military character is officially in development. Remus shared the news on social media alongside a teaser scene, noting that bringing this vision to the silver screen has been a longtime goal of his. He has asked his loyal wrestling and G.I. Joe fanbase to support the project by watching, sharing, and commenting on the newly released footage. While additional details such as the official title, cast, and release date remain unannounced, fans can follow the project's official Instagram account for future updates.

stories.title: Rey Fenix Reflects on WWE Raw Match Against Brother Penta
stories.tldr: Rey Fenix recently reflected on his emotional main event match against his brother Penta on the August 31 episode of WWE Raw, where they fought for a title shot against Roman Reigns. Although Fenix was saddened by losing the chance to challenge Reigns in Mexico City, his pride and happiness for his brother ultimately outweighed the defeat. Penta will now face Reigns on September 14 in Mexico City, while Fenix focuses on his own upcoming championship defenses.

stories.title: Dana Hall Shares Comments Regarding Triple H and Shawn Michaels
stories.tldr: Dana Hall, the ex-wife of the late Scott Hall, recently spoke out about her late ex-husband's struggles with addiction and the involvement of his Kliq stablemates. During a podcast interview, she recalled an attempted intervention involving Kevin Nash and Shawn Michaels that ultimately failed when they allegedly partied with Scott instead. Furthermore, she expressed hurt over Triple H and Shawn Michaels completely ignoring her at Scott's celebration of life.

stories.title: Sami Zayn Defeats CM Punk to Regain WWE Championship on SmackDown
stories.tldr: Sami Zayn defeated CM Punk to become a two-time Undisputed WWE Champion during the September 11 SmackDown in Mexico City. The chaotic main event featured heavy outside interference from Johnny Gargano, Candice LeRae, and Kevin Owens. Owens accidentally struck Punk with the title belt, allowing Zayn to capitalize with a low blow and a Helluva Kick. Now holding the gold again, Zayn immediately faces a crowded challenger queue including Punk, Owens, and Gargano, who had struck a pre-match deal for the first title shot.

stories.title: Damian Priest Turns Heel on R-Truth Following Tag Team Loss on SmackDown
stories.tldr: Damian Priest officially turned heel on R-Truth during Friday night's SmackDown in Mexico City after they failed to capture the AAA World Tag Team Championships from The War Raiders. Following the loss, Priest initially hugged Truth and placed a sombrero on his head before suddenly dropping him with a lariat and a South of Heaven chokeslam. The brutal betrayal effectively ends their six-month partnership, which previously included a run with the WWE Tag Team titles.

stories.title: Nikki Bella and Paige Escalate Feud Across Social Media and SmackDown
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella and Paige have taken their bitter personal feud to a new level following intense social media jabs and a chaotic match on SmackDown in Mexico City. Ahead of their bout, Nikki posted a cryptic reference to The New Day that fans interpreted as a shot at Paige's past leaked private video, prompting an angry profanity-laced threat from Paige. The rivalry then exploded in the ring where Paige crossed the line by spitting on Nikki's face before Nikki ultimately secured a controversial victory using illegal leverage.

stories.title: Mandy Rose Discusses Openness to Return with WWE, AEW, or TNA
stories.tldr: Former NXT Women's Champion Mandy Rose revealed that she would be open to taking calls from WWE, AEW, or TNA regarding a potential wrestling return. While she has no immediate timetable for a comeback, Rose noted she would consider stepping back into the ring or taking on a managerial role. She also emphasized that she holds no bitterness toward WWE following her 2022 release, expressing total contentment with her current life of marriage, motherhood, and financial independence.

stories.title: Danhausen Added to WWE 2K26 Roster and Explores Commercial Partnerships
stories.tldr: Following his massive merchandise success and crossover buzz, Danhausen has now officially made his video game debut as part of the WWE 2K26 roster. He headlines the newly launched Ringside Pass Season 5 as a Tier 1 unlock on the Premium Track. Additionally, outside of the virtual ring, the star is reportedly drawing serious interest from multiple NFL teams for upcoming in-stadium appearances and promotional partnerships.

stories.title: Bayley Contract Status and Future Expectations with WWE
stories.tldr: Clarification has emerged regarding Bayley's contract status, revealing that while she has not officially signed a new deal, she previously agreed to terms and is expected to finalize it soon. This confidence from management allowed her to immediately return to television and the road. She has already resumed her rivalry with Lyra Valkyria on Raw and performed on the recent South America live tour.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez Crowned #1 Contender for Reina de Reinas Title at Triplemanía 34
stories.tldr: Roxanne Perez won a fatal four-way match on night one of Triplemanía 34 in Las Vegas to become the new number one contender for the Reina de Reinas championship. She outlasted Nattie, Faby Apache, and La Hiedra following late-match interference from current titleholder Flammer. Perez will now move on to face the winner of the Flammer versus La Catalina championship match at the upcoming WWE and AAA Worlds Collide event on September 26 in Rosemont, Illinois.

stories.title: Liv Morgan vs. Stephanie Vaquer Set for WWE Live Event in Chile
stories.tldr: Following their controversial title match on Raw, WWE has officially booked a rematch between Liv Morgan and Stephanie Vaquer for the live event in Santiago, Chile. General Manager Adam Pearce announced that the showdown will feature Becky Lynch serving as the special guest referee. Lynch reacted to the announcement on social media as tension continues to build between the top contenders.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Retains WWE Women's Championship Against Nia Jax
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green has successfully defended her newly permanent WWE Women's Championship against Nia Jax on SmackDown in Mexico City. Despite wrestling in a protective face mask due to her orbital injury and surviving interference from Lash Legend with help from Tiffany Stratton, Green secured the controversial win. The finish featured a botched timing spot and a mask headbutt before Green hit the Killswitch to retain her title.

stories.title: Rey Fenix Retains AAA Cruiserweight Championship Against Ricky Saints on SmackDown
stories.tldr: Rey Fenix successfully defended the AAA Cruiserweight Championship against Ricky Saints on SmackDown in Mexico City. Despite a strong challenge and early control from Saints, Fenix secured the victory using his signature aerial offense and a decisive Mexican Muscle Buster. Following the match, Saints refused a post-match handshake, and Fenix now prepares to defend his title in a four-way match at AAA TripleMania 34.

stories.title: WWE Main Roster Crossovers and Talent Movements with AAA
stories.tldr: Following WWE's acquisition of Lucha Libre AAA, major roster movements and upcoming crossover appearances are taking shape around TripleMania 34. Current AAA stars like Flammer and Mr. Iguana are rumored to transition to the US WWE brands soon. Meanwhile, main roster names such as Ricky Saints, Logan Paul, and Chad Gable are lined up or heavily discussed for upcoming AAA television and event appearances.

stories.title: Zelina Vega Shares Animated Memorial Tribute to Father on 9/11 Anniversary
stories.tldr: Former wrestling star Xelina marked the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks by releasing an emotional animated tribute and her mother's StoryCorps video. Reflecting on her father Michael Trinidad's death, she shared that she no longer remembers his voice and is asking fans for any footage or stories to better understand him. She also opened up about her battle with depression at age 15, how wrestling saved her, and her continued goal to bring a World Championship to the 9/11 Memorial regardless of which promotion she wrestles for next.

stories.title: WWE Officials High on Royce Keys as Future World Champion
stories.tldr: Royce Keys is turning heads backstage following his return and main event push alongside the newly formed 946 faction. WWE officials are reportedly so impressed with his seamless transition that higher-ups already view him as a future World Champion. The faction, which now includes newly called-up tag team OTM, has been making waves on Raw through violent clashes with The Bloodline. Creative plans are firmly in place to keep pushing the group, with internal discussions pointing toward a prominent WarGames match.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu Set for Final Indie Appearance with Reality of Wrestling After WWE Signing
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu is making rapid waves in WWE and is reportedly being fast-tracked to the main roster due to massive digital engagement. Before fully committing to this next chapter, he is set to make his final independent wrestling appearance. He will return to Booker T's Reality of Wrestling promotion in Texas City for his emotional farewell match.

stories.title: Randy Orton Sets Sights on 15th WWE World Championship
stories.tldr: Following his chaotic victory over Cody Rhodes at Sunday Night's Main Event, Randy Orton addressed the WWE Universe on SmackDown in Mexico City. He explained that Rhodes ultimately lost because he hesitated and lacked the ruthlessness required to put him away. Orton then officially shifted his focus to capturing his 15th world championship. He concluded by putting the entire roster and the night's Undisputed Championship winner on notice with a stern RKO warning.

stories.title: Ethan Page Claims He Has the Smallest Ego in WWE
stories.tldr: Ethan Page doubled down on his controversial claims about WWE locker room dynamics during a recent interview, arguing that his moniker ironically reflects having the smallest ego in the company. He accused his peers of being vain liars driven strictly by money and fan manipulation while lacking authenticity. Page contrasted himself with the rest of the roster by stating his true motivation is fulfilling childhood championship dreams rather than selling merchandise.

stories.title: Charlotte Flair Discusses Wins, Losses, and WWE Creative Freedom
stories.tldr: Expanding on her recent podcast appearance, Charlotte Flair discussed how she overcame early struggles with charisma and learned to accept losses in a scripted sport. She explained that letting go of her competitive ego and showing personal flaws has helped refresh her character for the fans. Flair also noted that while she does not control match outcomes, WWE grants her significant freedom in putting together the actual in-ring action.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio Urges Patience Regarding WWE World Title Push
stories.tldr: Addressing ongoing discussions about his career trajectory, Dominik Mysterio is urging fans to remain patient regarding a future WWE World Championship push. Pointing out that he is only six years into his in-ring career and not yet 30, Mysterio noted that he is still growing as a performer. While he already boasts a strong résumé including multiple mid-card titles and his historic AAA Mega Championship reign, his immediate focus is set on his upcoming title defense at TripleMania 34.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer Reveals Origin of John Cena Heel Turn Idea
stories.tldr: While John Cena previously credited Triple H for his 2025 heel turn, reports reveal that Dwayne The Rock Johnson actually conceived the idea after plans to turn Cody Rhodes heel were rejected. Johnson pivoted to Cena for the Elimination Chamber angle but subsequently removed himself from the storyline, leaving WWE without a long-term plan for the run. Despite the creative shortcomings and lack of follow-up from The Rock at WrestleMania, Cena ultimately embraced the shift as a lucrative business move.

stories.title: Big Vinny V: Your AAA TripleMania 34 watchability guide
stories.tldr: Following his criticism of AAA's weak promotional buildup for TripleMania 34, wrestling analyst Big Vinny V has released a comprehensive watchability guide for the two-night event. Spanning the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas and Arena CDMX in Mexico City, the card features marquee bouts like Rey Mysterio versus Omos and Dominik Mysterio defending the Mega Championship against El Grande Americano. Vinny V breaks down the dozen matches across both nights into must-see highlights, potential show-stealers, and skippable encounters to help fans navigate the weekend.

stories.title: Historical Wrestling Retrospectives and Match Flashbacks for September 11
stories.tldr: September 11 holds a rich history in professional wrestling, marked by iconic matches, legendary ratings, and major title changes across various promotions. Notably, the date is anchored by the legendary 2005 TNA Unbreakable triple threat match between AJ Styles, Christopher Daniels, and Samoa Joe, which earned universal acclaim as one of the greatest bouts ever. Other historical milestones include classic encounters like Akira Taue versus Kenta Kobashi and significant championship victories for stars like Becky Lynch and AJ Styles at WWE Backlash 2016. Across decades, promotions ranging from WWE and TNA to AJPW and CMLL have seen championship shifts and critically acclaimed contests on this exact calendar date.

stories.title: Marisela Peña to Be Inducted into AAA Hall of Fame
stories.tldr: AAA President Marisela Pena has been announced as the next inductee into the AAA Hall of Fame. The major announcement was made during night one of Triplemania 34 in Las Vegas, Nevada. Her official induction ceremony is scheduled to take place on October 24, 2026, at the Heroes Inmortales event in Mexico City.

stories.title: Lady Shani Suffers Injury at AAA Triplemanía 34
stories.tldr: AAA veteran Lady Shani suffered a possible injury during the opening match of Triplemanía 34 Night One while competing in a mixed six-person tag team bout. The 33-year-old went down in the early stages of the match after seemingly taking a kick to her face, causing the contest to be paused for several minutes. She did not return to the match, and Adelicious, Mascarita Sagrada, and Mini Vikingo ultimately walked away with the win. Additionally, Panic Clown was not medically cleared for a separate trios match on the card and was replaced by Psycho Clown.

stories.title: Prosecutors Seek Incarceration for 2 Cold Scorpio Ahead of Sentencing
stories.tldr: Prosecutors in Kansas City, Missouri, have filed a motion to revoke the bond of veteran professional wrestler Charles Scaggs, better known as 2 Cold Scorpio, ahead of his October sentencing. Scaggs pleaded guilty in August to reduced charges of second-degree assault and armed criminal action following a June 2024 stabbing incident at a Love's Travel Stops location where he was working as security. Although Scaggs maintained the stabbing was in self-defense and had remained free on bond, a hearing is now set for September 17 to determine if he will be jailed before his October 9 sentencing.

stories.title: Backstage Update on 'Road Dogg' Brian James and TNA Wrestling Status
stories.tldr: Back in June 2026, WWE veteran Road Dogg Brian James was heavily expected to join TNA Wrestling in a creative role after appearing at Slammiversary and discussing potential talent acquisitions. Despite all signs pointing toward a finalized agreement, the deal ultimately fell through for reasons that remain unexplained by industry insiders. While future discussions have not been officially ruled out, there are currently no active talks or recent indications that James will be joining the company.

stories.title: Celebrities Attend AAA Triplemanía 34 Night One in Las Vegas
stories.tldr: The two-night Lucha Libre AAA Triplemanía 34 event kicked off on September 11th at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada. During the live broadcast, comedian Gabriel Iglesias and professional boxer Cain Sandoval were spotted enjoying the show from the front row. Night two of the event will take place on September 13th at Arena CDMX in Mexico City, Mexico. That upcoming card is headlined by Dominik Mysterio defending the AAA Mega Championship against El Grande Americano.

stories.title: Panic Clown Not Cleared to Compete at AAA Triplemanía 34
stories.tldr: Panic Clown has been pulled from the upcoming AAA Triplemanía 34 event after failing to receive medical clearance to compete. As a result, Psycho Clown will step in to take his place alongside Dave the Clown and Monster Clown as the Psycho Circus defends the World Trios Championship against Perros del Mal. While specific details regarding the nature and severity of Panic Clown's injury remain undisclosed, the change was announced live on the broadcast by lead commentator Corey Graves.

stories.title: Matt Cardona and Brian Myers Featured on Spider-Man Variant Cover
stories.tldr: Wrestling stars Matt Cardona and Brian Myers are stepping into the Marvel universe with a special comic book variant cover. The officially licensed artwork for The Amazing Spider-Man issue number 1001 features Spider-Man inside a wrestling ring alongside the company owners and Michael Kanik. Fans can currently pre-order the standard edition for twenty-four dollars and ninety-nine cents or opt for a graded CGC nine-point-eight collector edition. The issue itself continues the storyline from the milestone thousandth issue with Spider-Man battling Ravage while Aunt May gets caught in the crossfire.

stories.title: Santino Marella and Vladimir Kozlov Reunite for CW Road Rally Project
stories.tldr: Former WWE tag team partners Santino Marella and Oleg Prudius, better known as Vladimir Kozlov, are reuniting for a television project on The CW. The duo will participate in The Great American Road Rally: Celebrity Edition, a series hosted by Ian Ziering that features celebrity teams driving classic cars along Route 66. The 2,211-mile charity trip runs from the Chicago area to Santa Monica with a detour through Las Vegas, supporting various causes along the way. Prudius has been identified as a driver for the FDNY Foundation entry, which will receive a portion of the rally proceeds.

stories.title: 'The Iron Claw' Film Made Available Free on YouTube in the U.S.
stories.tldr: The critically acclaimed 2023 biographical drama The Iron Claw is currently available to stream for free on YouTube in the United States. Written and directed by Sean Durkin and distributed by A24, the film explores the legendary and tragic wrestling careers of the Von Erich family. The R rated movie features a star studded cast including Zac Efron, Jeremy Allen White, and Lily James.

stories.title: Tommy Dreamer and Robb Wells Announced for IPW Legacy Event
stories.tldr: Extreme Championship Wrestling legend Tommy Dreamer and Trailer Park Boys star Robb Wells, famous for his role as Ricky, have been announced for the upcoming IPW Legacy event. Additional wrestling stars including EC3 and Gisele Shaw are also slated to appear at the Woodstock, Ontario show for special appearances and fan interactions. The event takes place on October 24 at the Oxford Auditorium with multiple ticket tiers available for families and VIP guests. While specific matches have not yet been established, the evening promises a unique blend of professional wrestling and comedy culture.

stories.title: Scott D'Amore Announces Memorial Celebration of Life for Joe Doering
stories.tldr: Former wrestling executive Scott D'Amore has announced a public celebration of life to honor the late Joe Doering, scheduled for September 20 at the Walkerville Brewery in Windsor, Ontario. Doering tragically passed away in June at the age of 44 after a courageous and lengthy battle with brain cancer. The respected veteran was widely celebrated for his memorable and dominant runs in the ring with All Japan Pro Wrestling and TNA Impact Wrestling. Attendees wishing to pay their respects are asked to contact D'Amore directly via social media to help organizers estimate the expected turnout.

stories.title: Dana White Criticizes Boxing Promoter Eddie Hearn
stories.tldr: UFC President Dana White harshly criticized Matchroom Boxing promoter Eddie Hearn regarding the potential Anthony Joshua versus Tyson Fury super fight, which is considered the biggest in modern British boxing history. White accused Hearn of actively hurting the negotiations and jeopardizing the bout by insisting it take place in the UK, specifically at Cardiff Principality Stadium, rather than in the United States where significantly more money can be made. According to White, the historic matchup is now extremely close to falling apart and has become entirely silly due to these disagreements over location and revenue generation.

stories.title: TNA Bound for Glory 2026 Ticket Sales Update
stories.tldr: TNA Bound for Glory 2026 is facing a slow start in ticket sales with just a month remaining until the event at the Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida. Tracking data indicates that only 675 tickets have been distributed so far, reflecting a minor increase of 43 over the previous week. Meanwhile, the pay-per-view match card is beginning to take shape with major title bouts announced. Fans can currently purchase standard admission tickets starting at $59.35, though pricing adjustments are expected as the show draws closer.

stories.title: Omos Defeats Rey Mysterio to Gain Reinstatement at AAA Triplemanía 34
stories.tldr: At night one of AAA Triplemania 34 in Las Vegas, Omos defeated General Manager Rey Mysterio to successfully lift his suspension and earn full reinstatement. Despite outside interference and a frantic flurry of offense from Mysterio, the giant secured the win with a decisive chokeslam. Following the bell, Omos delivered a brutal post-match assault, culminating in chokeslamming Mysterio through the announce table while the General Manager was still strapped to a stretcher.

stories.title: Los Perros del Mal Win AAA World Trios Championship at Triplemanía 34
stories.tldr: Los Perros del Mal captured the AAA World Trios Championship on night one of Triplemanía 34 in Las Vegas. They defeated Los Psycho Circus, ending a massive 663-day title reign after a series of match disruptions and interference. Panic Clown was medically replaced by Psycho Clown, who was later lured away by El Carnicero to set up their upcoming street fight. This victory marks the first time Perros del Mal has held the trios titles since their run as inaugural champions in the early 2010s.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio Praises The Undertaker's Backstage Contributions to AAA
stories.tldr: Building on his new backstage producer role in AAA, The Undertaker has drawn high praise from AAA General Manager Rey Mysterio for successfully introducing long-term, WWE-style storytelling to the Mexican promotion. Mysterio hailed the approach as the perfect formula for the fanbase while preparing for his own high-stakes match against Omos at TripleMania 34. The bout, set for night one at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, features a stipulation where a Mysterio win permanently bans Omos, while an Omos victory reinstates him following a suspension for attacking Galeno and Mysterio.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Radio Covers Big Mexico Weekend and Bill Dundee Biography
stories.tldr: Recent audio coverage delved deeper into the industry with a detailed biographical look at Bill Dundee alongside discussions of Jerry Oates and his connection to Marty Jannetty. The latest episode also previewed a massive weekend of professional wrestling events scheduled across Mexico. Additionally, discussions touched on current roster updates regarding Bayley and the build toward the Rebel Heart edition of Dynamite.

stories.title: Will Ospreay discusses new match concepts, All In entrance, and Kenny Omega match
stories.tldr: Newly crowned AEW World Champion Will Ospreay recently reflected on his epic victory against Kenny Omega at AEW All In: London during a podcast appearance with Chris Van Vliet. He revealed that they had to improvise a last-minute finish dubbed Plan B after another match used their original spots, and noted they may never face each other again. Ospreay also discussed the emotional backstage entrance featuring his mother's voiceover, his talks with Tony Khan about introducing new sports-based match concepts to AEW, and his upcoming title defense against Jon Moxley at All Out.

stories.title: Outside wrestling stars backstage at AEW Rebel Heart Dynamite
stories.tldr: Numerous wrestling stars from outside AEW, including talent from TNA and MLW, were backstage at a special Athens, Georgia episode of Dynamite titled Rebel Heart. The emotional event was held in honor of Tanea Rebel Brooks as she continues her battle with terminal ALS, featuring heartfelt tributes alongside memorial moments for the late Andy Williams. Rebel made unforgettable on-screen appearances, including a touching segment with Dr. Britt Baker that brought fans and colleagues to tears.

stories.title: AEW and Upper Deck release Rebel collaboration cards
stories.tldr: AEW and Upper Deck have launched a special collaboration featuring a charity trading card honoring Rebel to support the fight against ALS. The Heroic Inspirations Rebel card is available through September 27, with base cards priced at $7.99 and limited edition autograph cards priced at $19.99, though the autographs have already sold out. One hundred percent of the proceeds are being donated to ALS organizations I Am ALS and Team Gleason. This initiative coincides with ongoing support from the wrestling community, including a recent emotional tribute episode of Dynamite titled Rebel Heart.

stories.title: Steve Maclin ambushes Adam Copeland backstage at AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Steve Maclin ambushed Adam Copeland backstage at a recent AEW Dynamite event, spraying him in the eyes with a mace-like weapon to escalate their cross-promotional feud for Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling. The attack sets up a blockbuster showdown between Copeland and Maclin at the upcoming Northern Rising event on October 3 at Toronto's Mattamy Athletic Centre, formerly known as Maple Leaf Gardens. Meanwhile, the promotion has also confirmed an undisputed Canadian Championship match between Josh Alexander and interim champion Stu Grayson, along with fallout matches featuring Rhino stepping up to defend Copeland's honor against Maclin.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight upset Young Bucks on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight have formed an unlikely tag team under the Don Callis Family and quickly scored major victories, culminating in a shocking tables match upset over the Young Bucks on AEW Dynamite. While Fletcher has traditionally excelled in singles competition and faces ongoing tension within the Don Callis faction, this high-profile tag team win gives the Young Bucks a meaningful feud to pursue while potentially setting the stage for Fletcher's eventual departure and babyface run. Analysts are weighing whether this pairing has long-term legs given a loaded tag division, or if it serves as a stepping stone for wider storylines.

stories.title: Brian Cage discusses PED use and AEW vs. WWE momentum
stories.tldr: AEW star Brian Cage recently appeared on The Smooth Vega podcast to discuss his physique and the broader landscape of professional wrestling. He openly admitted to using steroids, PEDs, TRT, HGH, and peptides, arguing that while these substances work, they are not a substitute for hard work and in-ring skill. Cage also claimed that a vast majority of people in wrestling and beyond use similar substances, though he is often unfairly singled out because of his physique. Additionally, he shared his thoughts on the Monday Night Wars-style momentum between promotions, boldly claiming that AEW pay-per-views smash WWE events and that AEW is currently on the upswing.

stories.title: AEW sending stars to CMLL event opposite WWE-backed AAA TripleMania
stories.tldr: AEW is sending several top stars to bolster CMLL's upcoming event in Mexico City, directly clashing with the second night of the WWE-backed AAA TripleMania. The star-studded card features marquee matches including PAC versus Mascara Dorada and Místico teaming with Mike Bailey. Meanwhile, in related CMLL news, Jeff Jarrett made a surprise appearance to challenge 65-year-old legend Blue Panther to a singles match for the upcoming 93rd Aniversario event, which was subsequently accepted.

stories.title: The Young Bucks set up for future AEW Tag Team Title run despite loss
stories.tldr: The Young Bucks recently suffered a defeat against Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight in a tables match on AEW Dynamite, immediately followed by the promotion of an upcoming ladder match involving The Bucks, FTR, and AEW Tag Team Champions Adam Copeland and Christian Cage. Wrestling Observer Radio's Dave Meltzer theorized that this sequence of losses is intentional booking to position Matt and Nick Jackson for a championship victory. According to Meltzer, putting the titles on the Young Bucks would successfully establish ready-made championship feuds with FTR, Copeland and Christian, and Fletcher and Knight. While this remains speculation and relies on them winning gold, it would provide AEW with months of pre-established tag team title programs.

stories.title: Absent AEW stars nearing returns to TV
stories.tldr: Several absent AEW stars are nearing potential returns to television following extended breaks due to filming, maternity leave, and unexplained absences. Former world champion Samoa Joe is expected back soon now that filming for the television series Twisted Metal has wrapped up. Meanwhile, Ruby Soho has been medically cleared to return to the ring following a pregnancy-related absence, and Kamille remains a candidate for a comeback with potential storylines involving Mercedes Mone.

stories.title: YouTube metric analysis for AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: A recent YouTube metric analysis of the Rebel Heart episode of AEW Dynamite highlights viewer interest across various uploaded segments. The show was dedicated to Rebel and her fight against ALS, with a segment involving her and Britt Baker taking the top spot in views. Meanwhile, Will Ospreay continued to prove his drawing power, capturing over a quarter of total views with his matches and segments. Interestingly, unlike some other promotions where fans prefer short clips, AEW viewers heavily engaged with longer in-ring content, particularly Ospreay and David Finlay's match.

stories.title: Jim Ross health updates and comments on Sting's son
stories.tldr: Following his recent in-ring debut, Steven Borden earned high praise from veteran commentator Jim Ross, who believes the young wrestler has main event potential. Meanwhile, Ross provided a personal health update, noting he is recovering well from recent brain surgery. However, his ongoing rehabilitation is currently being slowed by broken toes, weight management, and treatment for a lingering ankle wound.

stories.title: MJF allegedly claims exclusive right to wear plaid in wrestling
stories.tldr: AEW star Orange Cassidy recently discussed potentially retiring his longtime denim jacket while also sharing bizarre backstage claims from his rival MJF. According to Cassidy, MJF seriously believes he owns the exclusive rights to wear plaid in professional wrestling. Cassidy quickly dismissed the absurd demand, comparing it to claiming ownership of an entire color.

stories.title: AEW All Out teasing three-way Trios Title match
stories.tldr: Following a successful title defense, Swerve Strickland and The New Level were immediately confronted by multiple challengers on Dynamite. Hangman Page, Brody King, and Bandido aligned to enter the title picture alongside Ricochet and The Demand. Observers note that this chaotic standoff is clearly building toward a massive three-way AEW World Trios Championship match at All Out.

stories.title: Mick Foley praises recent moment from AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mick Foley recently attended the Rebel Heart edition of AEW Dynamite and declared a specific moment involving Tanea Rebel Brooks and Dr. Britt Baker to be among the greatest he has ever witnessed in wrestling. Foley was deeply moved by seeing Rebel ride away on her motorized scooter with Baker in her lap following a trios match, later praising her strength on Instagram. The emotional evening also featured appearances by several notable figures from the wrestling world and a massive $140,000 donation by AEW to ALS research organizations.

stories.title: AEW All Out 2026 ticket sales pacing ahead of World's End
stories.tldr: AEW All Out ticket sales have risen to 8,914, putting the upcoming September event on track to surpass the final attendance numbers of the Worlds End pay-per-view. Standard admission seats currently start at thirty-nine dollars as the show approaches its heavily discussed Illinois date. Meanwhile, the company has officially confirmed three high-stakes matches for the card. The lineup features a three-way tables, ladders, and chairs tag team match, a world title showdown, and a women's tag team street fight.

stories.title: Backstage reaction to unscripted Oba Femi and Bronson Reed moment on RAW
stories.tldr: During the September 7 episode of WWE Raw, an unscripted moment occurred when Bronson Reed placed his foot on a fallen Oba Femi, prompting Femi to swiftly push it away. This impromptu action caught WWE personnel off guard and generated noticeable backstage chatter and some negative reactions. Fans quickly took to social media to debate whether Femi broke character or if his reaction was justified within the bounds of his dominant persona. Despite the internal discussion, there is currently no indication that WWE plans to take disciplinary action or alter their booking plans for either superstar.

stories.title: Danhausen draws promotional interest from multiple NFL teams
stories.tldr: WWE star Danhausen is reportedly drawing interest from at least three NFL teams for promotional partnerships and in-stadium appearances following his successful crossover with the New York Knicks. WWE sources indicate the response to his crossover merchandise has been unprecedented, leading to internal expectations of a Fanatics NFL-Danhausen merchandise line later this season. Meanwhile, Danhausen continues to make waves across entertainment, reflecting on an unplanned WrestleMania 42 moment with John Cena and expressing a dream to guest star on The Simpsons.

stories.title: Club WWE fan vote to select WWE 2K27 cover superstar
stories.tldr: WWE and 2K have announced the first-ever WWE 2K27 Superstar Cover Fan Vote, giving registered members of the premium Club WWE platform the chance to select a cover star. Voting begins on Friday, September 11, with members limited to a single vote among eight nominated acts. The final winner will be officially revealed in early 2027 ahead of the game anticipated March release. Club WWE is a paid annual membership program launched earlier this year that offers exclusive perks, ticket access, and community features.

stories.title: Xelina (Zelina Vega) honors father on 25th anniversary of 9/11
stories.tldr: Former wrestling star Xelina, previously known as Zelina Vega, recently shared an emotional tribute to her late father, Michael Trinidad, ahead of the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks. During an interview, she reflected on their shared love of professional wrestling, how the sport helped pull her out of a deep depression following his death, and how her fans have supported her memory of him over the years. Although she previously brought her WWE United States Championship to the 9/11 Memorial, Xelina expressed a strong ambition to eventually return with a World Championship to fully honor a promise she made to her father. Following her departure from WWE earlier this year, she remains open to pursuing that goal in promotions like TNA, AEW, CMLL, or House of Glory.

stories.title: Georges St-Pierre attempts Randy Orton's RKO
stories.tldr: UFC legend Georges St-Pierre recently shared a social media clip of himself learning and attempting Randy Orton's famous WWE finishing move, the RKO. While the MMA icon's execution was far from picture-perfect, he approached the mechanics with his trademark analytical precision and joked about the move online. Randy Orton caught wind of the attempt and offered a gracious response, noting that imitation is the sincerest form of flattery.

stories.title: WWE considering Disney venues for future events and fan experiences
stories.tldr: WWE and Disney are reportedly discussing a major partnership for 2027 that extends far beyond traditional wrestling shows. Discussions have centered around utilizing venues like the ESPN Wide World of Sports Complex in Orlando for live events, festivals, and fan experiences tailored to family audiences. Additionally, WWE talent are expected to make crossover appearances on Disney+ programming over the next year. While ideas like a themed Disney cruise remain pure speculation, both brands are actively exploring ways to merge their audiences.

stories.title: Mandy Rose comments on WWE, sex appeal, and OnlyFans requests
stories.tldr: Former NXT Women's Champion Mandy Rose recently discussed her transition to subscription-based content, noting that WWE spent years monetizing her image as a sex symbol before she decided to take control of her own brand. Rose emphasized that running a successful platform requires treating it like a business and putting in substantial daily work rather than expecting easy money. She also shared insight into her subscriber base, revealing some of the bizarre wrestling-themed requests she receives, while praising the life-changing financial freedom and direct fan relationships the platform provides.

stories.title: Nikki Bella addresses Paige referencing John Cena on WWE SmackDown
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella recently addressed a fiery WWE SmackDown promo where Paige took a personal shot by referencing John Cena's famous motto. Speaking on her podcast, Nikki explained that she fully embraces bringing personal elements into feuds to entertain the crowd, noting the angle originated from fan chants in Canada. The high-profile rivalry culminates in Nikki's first singles match back from a severe ankle injury during WWE's major event in Mexico City.

stories.title: Mick Foley cast in holiday movie The Christmas Heartbeat
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mick Foley has joined the cast of the upcoming holiday movie The Christmas Heartbeat, which is set for a worldwide release on September 29, 2026. Vantage Media recently acquired distribution rights for the independent film, which was previously titled The Heart Brake. Directed by Lance Smith and inspired by executive producer Carrie Romero's real-life survival of cardiac arrest, the story follows a New York food critic returning to her Tennessee hometown to heal. While Foley's specific role remains under wraps, he stars alongside a notable cast including Brittany Curran, Beverly D'Angelo, and Joey Lawrence.

stories.title: Triple H contributing as writer for Amazing Spider-Man #1000
stories.tldr: WWE Chief Content Officer Paul Triple H Levesque and WWE Director of Character Development Rob Fee are listed among the writers contributing to the upcoming milestone Amazing Spider-Man #1000 comic book from Marvel Comics. Scheduled for release on September 30, the oversized issue features a story by Triple H and artist Ed McGuinness titled The Big Night. The WWE pair joins a star-studded contributor list that includes Joe Kelly, Noah Hawley, Frank Miller, Dan Slott, J.M. DeMatteis, Brian Michael Bendis, and Larry Lieber.

stories.title: Rusev medically cleared to return after WWE RAW injury scare
stories.tldr: CJ Perry has revealed that Rusev has been medically cleared to return to the ring following an injury scare during his July 27 match against Je Von Evans on WWE Raw. During the match at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles, Rusev experienced a terrifying moment where his arms and hands went completely numb, leading referees to consider stopping the bout. Despite online rumors and fan speculation suggesting he refused to finish the match to avoid losing, Perry clarified that he chose to push through the pain to do business before immediately seeking medical attention. Following a recent visit to the WWE Performance Center, Rusev has received full medical clearance and is preparing for his return.

stories.title: Logan Paul and Jake Paul to host fight reality series on ESPN & Hulu
stories.tldr: WWE star Logan Paul and his brother Jake Paul are teaming up to host and coach a new combat sports reality competition series airing on ESPN and Hulu. The untitled project, previously known as Fight Island, features contestants living and training together in the wild while competing in elimination fights across disciplines like MMA, boxing, wrestling, jiu-jitsu, Muay Thai, and karate. Competitors strategically choose their own matchups before Logan and Jake send the losers home until one man and one woman remain. Meanwhile, Logan is nearing a return to the WWE ring after being sidelined since May with a torn triceps.

stories.title: WWE Premium Live Event start times revealed for rest of 2026
stories.tldr: WWE has mapped out its Premium Live Event start times for the remainder of 2026, featuring a variety of international and domestic schedules tailored to specific host locations rather than a standard U.S. primetime window. Highlights include an afternoon Crown Jewel, a very early morning Wrestlepalooza broadcast from Australia, and a deliberate head to head scheduling conflict with AEW All Out for Worlds Collide in Illinois. As always, these times remain subject to change until officially confirmed by the company.

stories.title: WWE Guadalajara live event faces low attendance
stories.tldr:
WWE rolled into Guadalajara with CM Punk, Cody Rhodes, Randy Orton, Gunther, Charlotte Flair, Kevin Owens, Rey Fénix and a pile of other major names — and still had a whole lot of empty seats staring back at them.
William Beltrán of Superluchas.com sent word to Ringside News about the turnout at WWE

stories.title: Santos Escobar reflects on time in Latino World Order
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Santos Escobar recently reflected on his time with the Latino World Order during an interview with Denise Salcedo. He recalled initially pitching the stable to Triple H in NXT only to be turned down, until building enough equity to successfully reintroduce it alongside Rey Mysterio. Escobar also shared his thoughts on the ongoing success of the stable and the importance of authentic Latino storytelling and representation in professional wrestling.

stories.title: Interim WWE Women's Champion to be crowned following Rhea Ripley injury
stories.tldr: Following a knee injury and subsequent surgery that derailed Rhea Ripley's reign just over a month into her run as WWE Women's Champion, WWE has crowned Chelsea Green as the Interim WWE Women's Champion rather than stripping Ripley of the title. With Green currently sidelined with a broken orbital bone, her future as champion is uncertain as she prepares to defend the interim title against Nia Jax on Friday in Mexico City. Speculation is high regarding potential successors to the interim championship, with Nia Jax, Blake Monroe, and Tiffany Stratton all emerging as top contenders to potentially gold before Ripley eventually returns for a major unification match.

stories.title: Brandi Rhodes trained for WWE comeback before deciding against it
stories.tldr: Brandi Rhodes recently revealed on her podcast that she spent two weeks training at the WWE Performance Center for a potential in-ring return following her departure from AEW. Despite enjoying the experience and working with coaches like Norman Smiley and Fit Finlay, she ultimately decided against pursuing the comeback. The primary reason for her decision was the difficulty of being away from her young daughter, Liberty, who would cry and hold onto her every time she stepped out of the ring.

stories.title: NXT stars officially added to WWE main roster page
stories.tldr: Three rising WWE NXT stars have officially been added to the company official roster page following their recent television debuts. Dorian Van Dux, Romeo Moreno, and Myka Lockwood have all received official WWE biographies highlighting their unique backgrounds and recent successes. This update comes as NXT continues to refresh its talent pool following a wave of recent main roster call ups. Additional newcomers like Cruz Montana and Zilla Fatu have also made quick transitions to official roster status upon their arrivals.

stories.title: Sami Zayn potential opponent for WWE WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia
stories.tldr: With WWE WrestleMania 43 scheduled to emanate from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in April 2027, speculation has ramped up regarding Sami Zayn's potential opponent for the historic event. Given his immense popularity with audiences in the region, creative options range from world championship pursuits against Cody Rhodes, CM Punk, and Roman Reigns to personal grudges against Drew McIntyre and Trick Williams. Five primary scenarios emerge as compelling directions for Zayn at the Showcase of the Immortals as he looks to cement his legacy on international soil.

stories.title: Current list of free agent wrestlers in WWE
stories.tldr: While most WWE superstars are assigned to either Raw or SmackDown, a select group operates as brand-free agents who can appear on both shows. Currently, there are seven wrestlers holding this unique status, including returning veterans, recent call-ups, and international talents. This designation allows creative flexibility, though the practical difference between branded and unbranded stars is often fluid. The current roster of free agents features notable names such as AJ Lee, Brie Bella, Danhausen, Nikki Bella, Oba Femi, Omos, and Paige.

stories.title: Nick Khan calls Triple H the best creative mind in wrestling
stories.tldr: WWE President Nick Khan recently appeared on The Varsity with John Ourand to discuss corporate strategy, online criticism, and the current state of the company. During the interview, Khan praised Chief Content Officer Triple H, boldly calling him the best creative mind in all of professional wrestling. Khan also addressed how WWE handles fan backlash on social media, comparing it to standard sports complaints and emphasizing the importance of sticking to long-term plans rather than overreacting to internet noise.

stories.title: Joe Gacy hopes Wyatt Sicks reunite eventually
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Joe Gacy remains optimistic that the Wyatt Sicks faction will eventually reunite despite the members being released earlier this year and branching out onto the independent circuit. In a recent interview, Gacy revealed there were previously plans for the group to continue in some capacity and expressed his desire to get the band back together. While some members are already taking independent bookings together, others are currently keeping a lower profile or pursuing other wrestling ventures.

stories.title: Retro Flashback: Hornswoggle revealed as Vince McMahon's son on WWE RAW
stories.tldr: On September 10, 2007, WWE revealed Hornswoggle as the illegitimate son of Vince McMahon following a two-month storyline buildup. Mr. Kennedy was originally scheduled to receive the role in his hometown of Green Bay, but a suspension forced a sudden creative pivot to the leprechaun character. The reveal concluded with a live elimination segment that briefly tricked the audience into thinking Triple H was the mystery son before delivering a heavily panned punchline. Industry observers widely condemned the payoff, with Dave Meltzer labeling it one of the worst delivered surprises in company history.

stories.title: WWE creative push for Royce Keys, OTM, and 946 faction
stories.tldr: Royce Keys is earning massive backstage praise for his seamless transition into a main event role following his return and the formation of the 946 faction. Creative plans are already in motion to keep pushing the group heavily on Raw, with internal discussions pointing toward a potential WarGames match at Survivor Series. Additionally, Triple H has released new aftermath footage of the recent car-burning angle, while future plans for the stable could eventually involve adding a new member and exploring filmed origin vignettes.

stories.title: Seth Rollins makes in-ring return at WWE live event in Ecuador
stories.tldr: Following his extended post-SummerSlam absence, Seth Rollins officially made his in-ring return at a WWE live event in Quito, Ecuador. He teamed up with LA Knight and Solo Sikoa to defeat The Usos and Jacob Fatu in a six-man tag team match. Rollins is currently on tour with the company in South America, sparking speculation about an imminent television return on Monday Night Raw.

stories.title: Corey Graves on match-saving commentary and teasing in-ring return in AAA
stories.tldr: Corey Graves recently revealed he received medical clearance to wrestle years ago and has been back training in the gym. Beyond teasing a potential in-ring return specifically in AAA, where his brother Sam Adonis competes, he also detailed how announcers act as a safety net during matches. Graves explained that pre-match communication allows commentators to help steer the story back on track when things go wrong in the ring.

stories.title: Netflix strategy and WWE TV taping schedule changes
stories.tldr: Following the recent viewership drop on Netflix, Dave Meltzer reports that the streaming platform may discourage WWE from taping Raw days in advance. Meanwhile, WWE has announced rare double-tapings for Raw and SmackDown in November to accommodate upcoming premium live events. These scheduling shifts highlight the ongoing friction between traditional wrestling production calendars and streaming metrics.

stories.title: Grayson Waller reflects on low point of WWE main roster run
stories.tldr: Following his recent NXT Championship win, Grayson Waller revealed that being left off the card for WWE's previous tour of Australia was the lowest point of his main roster run. Despite proudly representing his home country as a self-proclaimed Aussie icon, management claimed they had no creative plans for him on those shows. Waller used the snub as motivation, fueled by a massive crowd reaction at a subsequent Main Event taping, and is now determined to secure a major spot when WWE returns to Australia in December 2026.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu reported for WWE main roster fast-track
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu is reportedly being fast-tracked to the WWE main roster following a meteoric rise through the NXT brand. Industry analysts note that his digital engagement and viewership rival top main roster stars like Cody Rhodes and Seth Rollins. WWE has bypassed a traditional developmental timeline, booking him in high-profile angles and drawing comparisons to dominant powerhouse Oba Femi.

stories.title: WWE planning surprises for RAW and SmackDown in Mexico City
stories.tldr: As WWE prepares for its historic Mexico City television tapings, new potential booking surprises have emerged alongside previously reported matches. Speculation now includes Sami Zayn capturing the Undisputed WWE Championship from CM Punk, Ricky Saints upsetting Rey Fenix for the AAA World Cruiserweight Championship, and Chad Gable crossing paths with El Grande Americano. Additionally, Rhea Ripley could make her return to confront Interim Women's Champion Chelsea Green.

stories.title: More WWE stars could join Cody Rhodes in Marvel Cinematic Universe
stories.tldr: Following a recent mysterious visit to Marvel Studios, Cody Rhodes has sparked heavy speculation that he could be cast as Havok in the upcoming X-Men film. This has opened the door for discussions on which other prominent WWE superstars might transition into the Marvel Cinematic Universe in the coming years. Analysts are eyeing names like Logan Paul, Liv Morgan, Roman Reigns, Ricky Saints, and Charlotte Flair for specific comic book roles as the franchise expands. As the MCU builds toward the end of Phase Six and looks ahead to future slates, Hollywood casting directors may increasingly look to the squared circle for athletic talent.

stories.title: The Rock early plans for WWE WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia
stories.tldr: Following the announcement that WrestleMania 43 will take place in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in 2027, speculation has begun regarding Dwayne The Rock Johnson's involvement in the historic event. Industry discussions highlight five potential creative directions for The Rock, ranging from marquee singles matches to executive enforcer roles. Potential plans include finally booking his long-awaited match against Roman Reigns, settling his ongoing rivalry with Cody Rhodes, or taking on a non-wrestling role like special guest referee.

stories.title: WWE intentionally scheduling events head-to-head with AEW All Out
stories.tldr: WWE Worlds Collide is outpacing AEW All Out in ticket sales for their upcoming simultaneous Illinois shows later this month. New reports indicate that WWE has deliberately scheduled Worlds Collide to start at 8 PM Eastern, putting it in direct time-slot competition with AEW All Out. This marks an escalation in the promotional battle between the two companies, who previously ran overlapping events with staggered start times.

stories.title: Ethan Page reflects on completing 20 years in professional wrestling
stories.tldr: Building on his recent controversial remarks about locker room authenticity, WWE Raw star Ethan Page is reflecting on his two decades in professional wrestling. The Canadian star recently discussed his rapid rise in WWE, comparing his career resilience and ability to survive industry changes to a cockroach. Page also revealed that his primary goal on the main roster is to finally capture the Intercontinental Championship.

stories.title: TNA Impact episode coverage, match results, and viewing details
stories.tldr: The September 10, 2026 episode of TNA Impact featured high-stakes championship defenses and continued build toward Bound For Glory. Nic Nemeth successfully defended the TNA World Championship against Matt Hardy in a brutal No Disqualification match, while Xia Brookside retained the Knockouts World Title against Gabby Forza after outside interference. The broadcast also showcased matches like Elayna Black versus Heather by Elegance, alongside notable commentary regarding upcoming storylines involving Moose and Frankie Kazarian.

stories.title: WWE and AAA planning surprises and unsigned talent for TripleMania 34
stories.tldr: WWE and AAA are gearing up for the two-night TripleMania 34 event, which spans Las Vegas and Mexico City. Reports indicate that several unexpected elements and unsigned talent are planned, particularly for the second night's Copa Bardahl match. Additionally, speculation has grown regarding potential surprise appearances, including Corey Graves expressing interest in a possible in-ring comeback with the promotion.

stories.title: Moose putting TNA career on the line against Frankie Kazarian
stories.tldr: Former TNA World Champion Moose has agreed to put his TNA career on the line in a high-stakes rematch against Frankie Kazarian on the upcoming September 17 episode of Thursday Night iMPACT. The match was made official after Kazarian repeatedly turned down Moose for a rematch following their previous encounter until Moose accepted the career-threatening stipulation. The loaded card for next week also features M by Elegance defending the Knockouts Television Championship against Kiera Hogan, alongside tag team action and ongoing developments for the upcoming Bound for Glory pay-per-view.

stories.title: Fabian Aichner qualifies for X-Division Title match at Bound For Glory
stories.tldr: Fabian Aichner secured his spot in the upcoming X-Division Championship match at TNA Bound For Glory 2026 by defeating former champion Rohit Raju on a recent episode of TNA Impact. Raju made his return to the company for the first time since the summer of 2025, putting up a strong fight before falling to Aichner's finishing maneuver. Aichner now joins KC Navarro in the six-way scramble match to crown a new champion, necessitated after previous titleholder Leon Slater vacated the belt to challenge Nic Nemeth for the TNA World Championship using Option C.

stories.title: Wrestling history: Top matches and title changes on September 10
stories.tldr: September 10 holds a rich history in professional wrestling, featuring numerous acclaimed matches and significant title changes across various global promotions. According to fan ratings and industry observers, standout bouts include the infamous AEW parking lot match in 2020 and a grueling three-way match in Progress Wrestling in 2017. Additionally, the date has seen 292 notable championship changes historically, ranging from classic NWA and AJPW tag and junior titles to chaotic WWE 24/7 title exchanges. This retrospective highlights the top-rated encounters and historical championship shifts that define this specific calendar day.

stories.title: Kosei Fujita challenging Aaron Wolf for NEVER Openweight Title at NJPW King of Pro-Wrestling
stories.tldr: New Japan Pro Wrestling has officially added a major championship match to the upcoming King of Pro Wrestling event on October 12 at Ryogoku Sumo Hall in Tokyo. TMDK member Kosei Fujita will challenge Aaron Wolf for the NEVER Openweight Championship following a heated feud that escalated through August and September. Fujita earned this historic opportunity after pinning Wolf during a recent main event following a violent war of words and a pull apart brawl. If successful, Fujita would join elite company as only the second junior heavyweight in history to win the NEVER Openweight title without officially changing weight divisions.

stories.title: Jun Kasai to face son Hinata Kasai at DDT Ultimate Party 2026
stories.tldr: Ultra-violent wrestling legend Jun Kasai is scheduled to face his own son, Hinata Kasai, in a high-profile singles match at DDT Pro Wrestling Ultimate Party 2026. Hinata debuted in 2025 and previously teamed with his father this past August at Wrestle Peter Pan. The father-son showdown highlights the November 3rd event at Ryogoku Sumo Hall in Tokyo, Japan. Additionally, the blockbuster card features a special tag team match pairing Kaisei Takechi and To-y against KANON and Kumadori.

stories.title: Jushin Thunder Liger to guest referee at TJPW Wrestle Princess VII
stories.tldr: Legendary Japanese wrestler Jushin Thunder Liger will return to action as a special guest referee for Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling. He will officiate the high-profile singles match between Mizuki and Hyper Misao at the upcoming Wrestle Princess VII event. The show is scheduled to take place at the EBARA WAVE Arena Ota on October 3rd. Although Liger officially retired at New Japan Pro-Wrestling Wrestle Kingdom in 2020, he has occasionally stepped back into the ring for select appearances in recent years.

stories.title: NJPW's Taichi presenting wrestling show at former middle school
stories.tldr: New Japan Pro-Wrestling star Taichi is returning to his alma mater in Hanakawa, Hokkaido, to host a special independent wrestling event for the second consecutive year. Titled Old School Pro-Wrestling and taking place on October 17, the unique show features cross-promotional action including a marquee tag team match. Taichi and a mystery partner will face Pro Wrestling NOAH veteran Naomichi Marufuji and a partner of Marufuji's choosing, reigniting a rivalry that dates back to the Suzuki-Gun era and their recent meeting at All Together in Sapporo.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano takes shot at WWE's viral-moment obsession in TNA promo
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Zoey Serrano seemingly took a subtle swipe at her former employer during a recent TNA promo on iMPACT. Reflecting on a career-altering injury after fourteen years in the business, Serrano stated she no longer needs to chase fifteen-second viral videos or pander to social media algorithms. By establishing her new purist mentality in TNA, she positioned herself as the future face of the Knockouts division. Fans and observers immediately connected her remarks to the modern industry focus on shareable viral moments and social engagement.

stories.title: Elayna Black hypes TNA Impact with social media post
stories.tldr: TNA star Elayna Black took to Instagram to promote Thursday night's episode of TNA iMPACT with a series of striking photos from Malibu, California. Posing in a black cutout swimsuit overlooking the Pacific Ocean, she kept her caption brief while directing fans to tune into the weekly show. The unconventional promotional post quickly garnered over 1,500 likes and successfully captured the audience's attention.

stories.title: NJPW sets dates for World Tag League 2026
stories.tldr: New Japan Pro-Wrestling has announced the full schedule and key dates for the upcoming World Tag League 2026 tournament. The 16-event tour officially kicks off at the Yokohama Budokan on November 23 and culminates with the grand final at Grand Messe Kumamoto on December 13. Fans can look forward to a preceding Road to show in Fujisawa, while official entrants, match cards, and ticket details will be released as they are finalized.

stories.title: Maple Leaf Pro to crown undisputed champion at Northern Rising PPV
stories.tldr: Maple Leaf Pro has announced that Canadian Champion Josh Alexander will face interim champion Stu Grayson to crown an undisputed champion at the Northern Rising pay-per-view on Saturday, October 3, in Toronto. Alexander returned in August after recovering from a knee injury sustained in March, leading to a confrontation with Grayson on MLP Mayhem that set up the title unification match. Additionally, the event will feature AEW star Adam Copeland squaring off against former TNA Champion Steve Maclin following a vicious backstage attack. The PPV takes place at the Mattamy Athletic Centre and will be available for purchase worldwide on MyAEW.

stories.title: Kevin Knight details grueling training at NJPW LA Dojo
stories.tldr: In a recent interview on the Battleground Podcast, Kevin Knight opened up about the grueling and monotonous training he endured as a Young Lion at the NJPW LA Dojo under Katsuyori Shibata. He discussed the challenges of overcoming a language barrier, performing domestic chores like cooking and cleaning, and lacking live audience feedback during the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite these initial hardships, Knight credits the intense experience with teaching him invaluable patience and shaping him into a better overall performer now starring in promotions like AEW.

stories.title: Wrestling world remembers Andy 'The Butcher' Williams
stories.tldr: Following the tragic passing of Andy The Butcher Williams at age 48, police details have emerged indicating he struck his head on a ring post during his match before experiencing a medical emergency. Tributes continue to pour in from across the wrestling industry, including deeply personal memories shared by peers like Matt Hardy, Natalya, and Malakai Black. Additionally, the wrestling community mourns the loss of territory legend Superstar Bill Dundee, who passed away on the same day at age 82.
